title: YOUR FIRST YOYO
content:
History / About
YOUR FIRST YOYO is a beginner-focused, responsive pull-back model released November 24, 2025. It's designed to use the same parts and tolerances as YYR's competition yo-yos, so beginners get high performance in an easy-to-use package.

title: Arabica SS
content: AboutThe Arabica SS is YOYO Barista's stainless steel-rimmed bimetal competition throw, named after Arabica coffee — the most widely consumed coffee species. A special edition colorway, "Arabicass Espresso Milk," was produced in collaboration with the Fist Salud crew, making it one of the brand's more collectible releases. Exact specifications are not fully documented in public sources.

title: Blend 01
content: AboutThe Blend 01 is a 2024 release from YOYO Barista, sold exclusively through the yoyobox store. At 57mm diameter it is the largest model in the lineup. Features a curved Size C bearing and M4×10mm axle. Named after a coffee blend, continuing the brand's coffee-themed catalog.

title: Cappuccino
content: AboutThe Cappuccino is YOYO Barista's 2021 model, positioned for professional play. Named after the cappuccino — espresso topped with steamed milk foam. Specific specifications are not fully documented in public sources. Listed on AliExpress at approximately $20.79 USD.

title: Colombia
content: AboutThe Colombia is YOYO Barista's bimetal competition model, named after Colombia's famous coffee-growing region. The 6061 aluminum body is paired with stainless steel rim rings for concentrated rim weight and the stability expected of competition play. Described as "exceptionally high quality and solid feel" for its price point. The mountain/volcano peak logo is prominently engraved on the cup face. Available in splash and acid-wash colorways.

title: Conpanna
content: AboutThe Conpanna (also written "Copanna") is YOYO Barista's polycarbonate-rimmed hybrid model, named after the Italian espresso drink con panna (espresso with whipped cream). The aluminum alloy body is paired with polycarbonate outer rims in a butterfly-wing profile. Unresponsive; bind required. Colorways: Silver/Black rim, Yellow/Black rim, Gray/Black rim. Sold through Youniverstore (Taiwan) at clearance pricing, suggesting the run has been discontinued.

title: Macchiato
content: AboutThe Macchiato is YOYO Barista's first yo-yo, released in 2019. An all-aluminum monometal, it established the brand's identity: coffee-themed naming, accessible pricing, and solid competitive performance. Colorways included Sky Blue and Turquoise. The mountain/volcano peak logo is engraved on the cup face.

title: Robusta
content: AboutThe Robusta is a collaboration between YOYO Barista and Chinese manufacturer Top Yo, released in 2019. Named after Robusta coffee beans, it introduced an innovative "through-structured" bimetal construction in which a dense stainless steel weight ring passes through the 7003 aluminum body and is visible from both the front and side of the yo-yo. This design concentrates mass at the rim for exceptional stability and spin power while maintaining a clean profile. The Robusta received wide Western distribution through YoYoExpert and YoYoSam, bringing YOYO Barista to a global audience. Colorways: Silver/Black Rings, Green/Black Rings, Black/Gold Rings, Pink/Gold Rings.

title: Seasons
content: AboutThe Seasons is YOYO Barista's most recent bimetal competition release, featuring a 6061 aluminum body with stainless steel rim rings and an exceptionally wide 50mm width for modern string control and trick composition. Available in Emerald, Red, Navy, and Silver colorways at SGD $77.00 through yoyoshopsg (Singapore).

title: BadBoy
content: History / AboutBadBoy is an aluminum YoYo Empire model listed by YoSam at 67 g, 54 mm diameter, 40 mm width, 4.76 mm gap and a 6.35 x 12.7 x 4.76 mm bearing. YoSam's listing is dated January 2020.

title: Big Bang (2026)
content: History / AboutPer YoSam and Yoyo Store Rewind, the 2026 Big Bang is a POM-bodied yo-yo with detachable polycarbonate rings. An internal reversible spacer changes the gap, converting it between a wide-gap bind 1A string-trick yo-yo and a narrower-gap 4A off-string yo-yo, where it plays at a smaller effective diameter.YoSam lists weight 77.09 g, width 63 mm, diameter 68 mm, and a size C bearing. The PC rings can be removed for lighter weight.

title: Big Bang (original)
content: History / AboutA forum member in August 2018 described the YoyoEmpire Big Bang as an oversized yo-yo about 65 mm in diameter made of delrin with an aluminum weight ring, and remarked that YoyoEmpire had poor distribution in the West.

title: Black Bean
content: History / AboutBlack Bean is a polycarbonate 2A looping yo-yo from YoYo Empire, listed by YoSam at 54 g, 58.8 mm diameter and 29.5 mm width, in matte green and glossy orange.

title: Boreas II (PC)
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Boreas II (PC) is the polycarbonate version of Boreas II with the same shape, weight and finger-spin spot. It feels lighter and faster than POM and has a blasted-smooth finish.

title: Boreas II (POM)
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Boreas II (POM) is the S-curve inverse-round member of the mono-POM line, wide yet comfortable in the hand. PC and stainless-rim (Boreas Pro II) variants also exist.

title: Boreas Pro II
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Boreas Pro II is the polycarbonate Boreas II with stainless-steel rim weights, with a side-face rim echoing the Eurus shape. It is a harder, heavier, power-oriented version.

title: Cloud Fly
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Cloud Fly is a mini-size H-profile yo-yo made entirely of stainless steel. Its small size avoids excess weight, and it uses a size D bearing, smaller than size C.

title: Empire Star
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Empire Star is a round-profile plastic yo-yo machined from Delrin like a full-metal model, with a metal weight ring inside the rim for added spin power. It is the sibling of Empire Sun. Two spare pads are included.

title: Empire Sun
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Empire Sun is a machined-Delrin yo-yo with a low-edge, strongly inverse-round shape to reduce string contact, praised by Rewind for stability among plastic yo-yos. Its shape is similar to the full-metal Promise. Hex nut, bolt and body colors are combinable.

title: Eurus (PC)
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Eurus (PC) is the polycarbonate version of the H-profile Eurus, in the shared-weight Boreas II/Notus/Eurus/Zephyr line. Same weight as POM, lighter feel, blasted-smooth finish; suited to players wanting stability in a wide body.

title: Eurus (POM)
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Eurus (POM) is the H-profile member of the mono-POM line, a powerful-feeling wide shape.

title: Fire Spirit EX
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Fire Spirit EX has a machined polycarbonate body with a stainless-steel rim, a bi-material design with a very wide body of over 50 mm and a central finger-spin hub.

title: Gungnir
content: History / AboutPer YoSam, Gungnir is a full titanium yo-yo created for the 11th anniversary of YoYo Empire, with a limited run of 29 pieces, each shipped with a commemorative coin. Specs: 66.1 g, 47.5 mm width, 57 mm diameter.

title: Little Fox II
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Little Fox II is an inexpensive bi-metal with an aluminum body and a stainless-steel rim placed near the step in a mid-weight layout. Rewind describes it as a mid-size, easy-handling step-up from first binds.

title: Lork
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Lork is an all-round off-string yo-yo with an S-curve profile and double-rim structure, sized between small and large off-string designs, with a side-face finger-spin spot. The listing recommends non-branded K-type string.

title: Myth
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Myth is a three-step mid-size yo-yo whose width equals or exceeds its diameter, an unusual concept. Rewind says weight distribution is tuned to resist wobble and that it handles easily despite the look. Two spare pads included.

title: Nimbus Rider
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Nimbus Rider adds aluminum rim weights to the earlier off-string Nimbus, in a structure resembling Lork's double rim with the side-face rim replaced by aluminum.

title: Notus
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Notus is the double-rim, round-profile member of the mono-POM line, soft but heavy-feeling.

title: Possess
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Possess is YoYo Empire's high-end bi-metal with stainless rims placed twice. Weight is centered in the step-straight area; it is about 44 mm wide and close to 67 g.

title: Possess II
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Possess II updates YoYo Empire's signature double stainless-rim bi-metal. The body changes to A7075 and is thinner to increase the weight difference with the rims; the rims sit further out, and total weight is slightly lower.

title: Promise
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Promise is a full-metal yo-yo with an H-profile-like low edge, thick rims and hub stacks. The raised bump at the response area keeps string off the body for less spin loss. Colorway names are body/stack color.

title: Rainfly
content: History / AboutYoSam describes Rainfly as YoYo Empire's flagship model: a stainless-steel rim wraps the outer edge of a 6061 aluminum body and overlaps inside the cup, giving long spin time. Specifications per YoSam: 56.5 mm diameter, 43.5 mm width, 64.6 g, size C concave ceramic/steel hybrid bearing and 19 mm silicone pads. Later versions include Rainfly II and the 2026 Rainfly EX.

title: Rainfly EX
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Rainfly is YoYo Empire's flagship bi-metal, and the EX is a 2026 renewal reshaped to current freestyle trends. Width exceeds 50 mm with broader stainless-steel rims, and the body is A7075 aluminum. The listing says the combination of size and hard alloy keeps it responsive despite the large body.

title: Rainfly II
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Rainfly II is YoYo Empire's flagship bi-metal: a stainless outer rim wrapping the outer edge of an A7075 body, in a conventional size and weight. It ships with a ceramic-ball curved bearing.

title: Skilfingr
content: History / AboutSkilfingr is the latest signature 5A (counterweight) yo-yo of Naoki 'Noppo' Uemae, per YoSam's listing, re-engineered for modern counterweight play. It uses a D-size bearing so shorter strings still wrap more, and a 'solid core' construction that secures the bearing on the solid axle. Specs: diameter 56 mm, width 54 mm, weight 68.9 g, aluminum with stainless-steel rings.

title: Sword
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Sword is a mid-size, full-metal string-trick yo-yo that is bind-required out of the box and ships with a concave (center-dished) bearing, round plus inverse-round shape with a low edge, and supports hub stacks.

title: Tsunami
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Tsunami pairs a POM body with a stainless-steel rim and adds a separate POM ring at the edge, giving unusual colorways. The finger-spin spot has a high wall.

title: Zenith
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Zenith is an off-string tri-material design: polycarbonate body, aluminum alloy inner rim and stainless-steel outer rim, with a titanium center nut. The listing says it suits solo-ham (two-yo-yo) play as well.

title: Zephyr (PC)
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Zephyr (PC) is the polycarbonate version of the Zephyr. Boreas II, Notus, Eurus and Zephyr share weight, size and side-face finger-spin spot so the shapes can be compared. The PC version is the same weight as POM but feels lighter and faster and has a blasted-smooth finish. Zephyr is the straight-profile, sharp-feeling shape.

title: Zephyr (POM)
content: History / AboutDescription paraphrased from the Japanese retailer Yoyo Store Rewind listing. Zephyr (POM) is part of YoYo Empire's mono-POM line with Boreas II, Notus and Eurus, sharing weight, size, material and side-face finger-spin spot. Zephyr is the straight-profile, sharp-feeling shape.

title: Elan Steampunk (Prototype)
content: History / AboutElan Steampunk was sold by Rewind as a prototype from YOYO Laboratory. It is the OEM source model of Sturm Panzer's SY-003 Schneider, though specs differ slightly. It is a full-size bimetal yo-yo with a straight profile in which nearly half the profile is brass. It is slightly lighter than the Schneider, with a non-through axle, and response compatible with YYF CBC slim-size. The rim is raw (untreated) brass that can be polished; the body is anodized. The sale lot included the yo-yo-shaped counterweight Pino. The store notes that production specs may differ from the prototype.

title: Phalanx
content: History / AboutPhalanx is a wide-body full-metal yo-yo from YOYO Laboratory. Rewind describes the aim as an easy, quirk-free feel: widening a body alone loses stability and adding weight blindly makes the feel harsh, so the shape was calculated to be broadly acceptable. The design includes involvement from Mr. Usuno (薄野), who studies yo-yo mechanics, and is described as a collaboration between YOYO Laboratory and yo-yo mechanics; every dimension was derived by calculation for the intended feel. It is shipped with a replacement titanium axle.

title: Raven
content: History / AboutRaven is the first model in YOYO Laboratory's S Series, the company's signature-model line. It is a full-metal yo-yo with a slender inverse-round shape and brass weights set inside the rim; at 51 mm diameter it is an undersized body, and the denser weights concentrate mass at the outer edge for strong spin and mobility. The inverse-round shape keeps the string away from the body. Weight is 67 g. It ships with an Ir pad (YYR silicone pad, C-size bearing, normal hardness, standard thickness) and accepts Joker pads and YYR silicone pads. Rewind notes some unit-to-unit wobble due to manufacturing and part structure.

title: Style
content: History / AboutStyle is described by Rewind as a mid-size yo-yo with top-class spin performance and the OEM source product for Sturm Panzer's Leo Sniper. It combines a brass weight ring (nearly half of the total weight), a small D-size bearing and a three-step inverse-round shape in an ultra-super duralumin body. The store states its initial spin RPM after the throw exceeds that of Stealth Ogre, another model on which YOYO Laboratory cooperated. The listed product is the production version, about 4 g lighter than the pre-release (66.7 g to 62.6 g); other specs are unchanged. Ships with an Ir pad. Strong impacts may shift or loosen the rim.

title: Hendiatris
content: History / AboutHendiatris is the second main-series yoyoball release. YoYoExpert describes a bi-metal design with a 7068 aluminum body and stainless-steel rings, plus a free-spinning shell over the inner catch zone that cuts string friction and extends horizontal spin time while keeping weight low. It retains the ability to swap halves with Plot Armor. Released July 2022.

title: Monomyth (Prooemium) (Prototype)
content: History / AboutAccording to kadabrium's November 2020 forum post, a titanium adaptation of Plot Armor was devised early in development to test design parameters and became known as the Monomyth. Four unengraved prototypes were released under the name 'Monomyth Prooemium', with two remaining available at the time of the post, and the next run was expected to add a logo with no design change.

title: Plot Armor
content: History / AboutPlot Armor is the first release of yoyoball, a company started by forum member kadabrium. YoYoExpert describes the line as built on a controlled-variable approach: the side profile stays the same across installments while material and weight vary, so halves can be swapped between models with coinciding centers of gravity. Plot Armor has a V-shaped profile in 7068 aluminum with a boutique US-made surface treatment. A preliminary run of 70 was being anodized in late 2020 per the maker's forum post; YoYoExpert released it in June 2021.

title: AIRA
content:
About
The AIRA is YoyoChampion's lightest yoyo at 50 grams, designed to develop player technique rather than mask it. The reduced weight provides immediate feedback — off-axis spins, poor string alignment, and sloppy mounts become apparent in a way heavier throws conceal. The metal cap construction distributes the limited weight toward the outer rim for stability. Functions as an effective training tool and a competition option for style-focused play.
Colorways
Available in Confetti, Galaxy Void, Aqua Mist, and Blue Steel. Retail price $48.99–$53.99.

title: G Force
content:
About
The G Force is YoyoChampion's hybrid construction throw — a frosted polycarbonate body paired with stainless steel rims for precise weight distribution at the outermost edge. The 56mm wide profile provides a large catch zone designed for modern competitive play. Team edition colorways were produced in collaboration with YoyoChampion Contest Team members Thomas Rajan (Fire Red) and James Heder (Electric Yellow), each limited to 100 pieces.
Colorways
Available in Fire Red (Thomas Rajan Ed.), Electric Yellow (James Heder Ed.), Galaxy Fade, Glacier Ice, Speed Club Ed., and Frosted Rainbow. Retail price $110.00–$119.99.

title: G Speed
content:
About
The G Speed is YoyoChampion's compact full-metal performance throw, designed for speed trick specialists. At 52mm diameter with a 50mm width it is engineered for the rapid transitions and tight mounts demanded by modern speed-focused freestyle routines. Suited for intermediate to advanced players.
Colorways
Available in British Racing Green, Nitro Splash, Boosted Blue, and Podium Gold. Retail price $44.99–$49.99.

title: Super G (YoyoChampion Edition)
content:
About
The Super G (YoyoChampion Edition) is the first exclusive release from Gentry Stein's own brand. A reimagining of the Super G that launched his signature career at YoyoFactory in 2010, this version pushes the wide-body profile to 56mm in both diameter and width for maximum stability and spin time. Suited for bangers, slacks, godspeed, and horizontal play.
Colorways
Available in Shiny Gold, Silver w/Red Splash Polished Rims, Galaxy, Silver/Orange Fade w/Aqua Splash, Aqua Wavelength Edition, and Prague Edition. Retail price $65.00.

title: Titanium Shutter Elite
content:
About
The Titanium Shutter Elite shares the exact geometry of the Shutter Elite Bimetal (56mm × 49mm, 66.8g) but is machined entirely from solid titanium. The weight distribution differs meaningfully from the bimetal version — titanium's density allows rim weighting without a stainless steel insert construction. Limited to 150 pieces. A B-grade variant (cosmetic blemishes only) was also made available at $200. Manufactured by YoyoFactory.

title: YOYOCOIN
content:
From One Drop:

"YOYOCOIN is a physical coin manufactured by One Drop YoYos. It is essentially a coupon that can be traded for a discount on One Drop YoYos product in person with a fluctuating value."

YOYOCOINs are brass coins manufactured by One Drop, with a total of only 100 in circulation. They are handed out randomly with orders, or at events where One Drop has a presence. Their value is loosely based off Bitcoin, and can only be redeemed in-person at One Drop's factory or at an event at a One Drop booth.

The current value of YOYOCOIN can be found at the upper-right hand corner of the One Drop website.

title: Eight Eight Eight (888)
content: About the 888The 888 is the yo-yo that established YoyoFactory as a premier competition brand. Released in 2007, its compact 50.55mm diameter and undersized profile made it extraordinarily agile for complex string tricks. At the 2007 World Yo-Yo Contest, half the finalists chose to compete with the 888 — an almost unprecedented level of dominance for a single model. Built from 6061 aluminum with a Center Trac Large bearing and 19mm Slim Pad response, the 888 shipped with Hubstack posts built into the design, allowing players to grab the spinning yo-yo mid-trick. The 888 went through numerous production runs: the 2007 "07 art" version, the 2008 "08 art" revision, and various Champions Collection runs. Colorways include Black (07 art), Red, Aqua Classic, Silver (08 art), Aqua Champions Collection, Black (stealth), and Aqua Big 8s. Price: $59.99. The 888 is widely regarded as one of the most historically significant yo-yos ever made.

title: 99 Dragons
content: About the 99 DragonsThe 99 Dragons is the bimetal evolution of the Nine Dragons, adding denser metal rims to the spinning-shell concept. The outer rim weight creates momentum unmatched by any spinning-cap yo-yo, extending spin time dramatically while maintaining the Dragon's signature independently-spinning shell trick capability. The main body uses a Large Center Trac bearing and CBC 19mm slim pads. At 75.7g it is lighter than the original Nine Dragons despite the metal rims. Available in Red/Silver, Aqua/Silver, and Green/Silver at $99.00 (compare at $105.00).

title: Abyss
content: About the AbyssThe Abyss is the debut signature model of Japanese player Kento Noda, developed with Shingo Terada's SUS Mechanics studio. It blends modern profile aesthetics with throwback-inspired curves, delivering powerful spins suitable for practice, competition, and casual play. The 6061 aluminum body at 55.97mm diameter and 44.15mm width provides a versatile, comfortable profile. Released August 2023 at $44.99–$54.99. Available in Red, Shiny Teal, Fire, Green, and Splash (Navy/Pink/Gold).

title: Abyss (JDS)
content: About the Abyss JDSThe Abyss JDS is a wider-body variant of the Kento Noda Abyss signature, tuned for the Japan Design Studio (JDS) lineup. It expands the catch zone for competitive play while maintaining the smooth step-round profile of the original Abyss. Available in Red, with JDS-exclusive colorways at $44.99.

title: Aerial
content: About the AerialThe Aerial is the signature 5A (counterweight) yo-yo of Shingo "Terry" Terada, 2001 X-Division World Champion and head of SUS YOYO MECHANICS. Built from POM (Delrin), its deliberately rounded body reduces injury risk during the wild throws and catches of 5A play, while the 46.15mm width provides a forgiving catch zone. It is also fully capable as a 1A string trick yo-yo. Available in Blue and Red at $45.00.

title: Arrow
content: About the ArrowThe Arrow is an intermediate adjustable plastic yo-yo with an aluminum fingerspin hub built into the cap. The gap can be widened to enable unresponsive play, making it a genuine stepping stone between the Velocity and full-metal unresponsive throws. The fingerspin dimple on the aluminum hub allows players to learn DNA-style tricks at an affordable price. Available in Red/Black Cap, Green/White Cap, Glow in the Dark, and Galaxy/White Cap variants at $17.99. It is recommended in YoyoFactory's "Cheat Code" learn path.

title: Astral
content: About the AstralThe Astral was designed by Shingo "Terry" Terada's SUS YOYO MECHANICS studio for YoyoFactory Japan. Its concept: give players a precision yo-yo that performs at metal levels without the cost anxiety of dinged aluminum. Built from machined polycarbonate (a combination of PC, ABS, and PS), it delivers a Center Trac bearing, slim 19mm response, and a round body shape tuned for stability and speed. Terada is the 2001 X-Division World Champion. The Astral retails for $29.99 and is available in Black+Red, Pink+Red, Yellow+Yellow, Light Blue+Black, and Clear+Purple.

title: Atom Smasher
content: About the Atom SmasherThe Atom Smasher is YoyoFactory's budget-tier unresponsive polycarbonate throw with an integrated aluminum fingerspin hub. At $19.99 it bridges the gap between the Arrow and the Wedge, offering a full unresponsive setup with genuine fingerspin capability. The 57.40mm diameter and 44.60mm width provide a competitive-sized platform. Available in Glitter/Black, Orange, Rayon Vert Green, Fire Marble, and Galaxy colorways.

title: Aviator
content:
About
The Aviator is a bimetal yo-yo from YoyoFactory released in 2014. Machined from 7075 high-strength aluminum with steel weight rings, it was part of YoyoFactory's early push into the premium bimetal category. The aerodynamic profile and rim-weighted design translate into long, powerful spins suited for competitive performance at the highest level.

title: Axolotl
content: About the AxolotlThe Axolotl plastic is Betty Gallegos's signature model and YoyoFactory's most capable convertible plastic. It ships with two bearings: a half-spec bearing for responsive play and a Center Trac for unresponsive. Switching between them changes the gap width from 2.8mm (responsive) to 4.3mm (unresponsive), allowing one yo-yo to serve from beginner through advanced practice. The polycarbonate body features an aluminum hub that enables genuine fingerspin tricks. Gallegos designed colorways including Gold, Green Purple, White, Aurora, and Red/White at $17.99.

title: Axolotl Metal
content: About the Axolotl MetalThe Axolotl Metal is Betty Gallegos's full-aluminum signature, a step up from her plastic Axolotl. At 57.10mm diameter and 42.24mm width in 6061 aluminum with a Size C bearing and 19mm slim pad response, it is optimized for speed and stability in fingerspin and horizontal tricks. Available in Aurora Splash, Silver, Gold, Green/Silver Fade, Green/Purple Splash, Purple/Green Fade, and Red/Black at $49.99.

title: BALLS
content: About the BALLSBALLS is exactly what it sounds like: two round balls of 6061 aluminum forming a yo-yo via a 10mm stainless steel axle. The 50mm diameter and 100mm width (effectively two 50mm balls side by side) produce unconventional physics that nevertheless enable real unresponsive play. The Large CT bearing and 19mm large pads provide standard response geometry despite the unusual body. Available with optional stand (sold separately). Available in Purple TCS, Blue Fuzzy, Gold, Silver Matte, and Green Fuzzy at $49.99.

title: Beyond
content: About the BeyondThe Beyond is engineered around a singular claim: the largest steel rims ever used on a professional yo-yo. The compact 53.40mm diameter concentrates that rim weight aggressively, producing stability and spin power that YoyoFactory describes as pushing performance "beyond expectations." At 64.8g with a 47mm wide catch zone and a Size C Center Trac bearing, it is designed for long combos, horizontal tricks, and competitive sequences. Available in Green/Gold Rim, Yellow/Orange/Gold Rim, Gold Champion, and Black/Silver at $99.00.

title: Big Deal
content: About the Big DealThe Big Deal is "the world's smallest triple-bearing yo-yo" built from solid stainless steel. At 25.75mm diameter and 27.2mm width, it fits completely in the palm — yet delivers spin times and trick capability far beyond what its scale implies. The triple-bearing system (Size K / Loop 720 format) provides the same Hubstack-style grab functionality as larger triple-bearing designs. Ships with two strings in a pouch. Warning: not suitable for young children due to small size and heavy construction. Available as a single SKU at $65.00.

title: BiMetal
content: About the BiMetalThe YoyoFactory BiMetal is the brand's mid-range bimetal platform: aluminum body with dense stainless steel rims concentrating weight at the outer edges for exceptional stability and extended spin. The precision fingerspin dimple on the hub and the 46mm catch zone handle both string tricks and fingerspin combinations. Smooth and silent via the Large Center Trac bearing. Available in Aqua/Violet, Blue/Aqua Fade, Black, Red Cherry, Blue, and Black/Silver Fade at $54.99 (compare at $60.00).

title: BoHo Wooden
content: About the BoHo WoodenThe BoHo is a beginner-friendly wooden yo-yo handcrafted from eco-friendly beech wood in the Czech Republic, featuring double-sided engravings of sun and mountain motifs. It plays with a fixed wooden axle for classic responsive returns. Ships with spare string and instructional materials. Available as a single SKU at $9.99.

title: BRILLO
content: About the BRILLOBRILLO is the debut signature of Kris Toledo, named after the Spanish word for "shine" and nicknamed "Mr. Clean." The 6061 aluminum body features an extra-wide 51.4mm profile with chunky rims and solid spin power for competition-level performance. The slightly heavier 67.1g build provides excellent control and responsive binds. Toledo designed each colorway with personal meaning: Aqua honors his "Mr. Clean" nickname, Black/White is named "Oreo the Dog" after his pet, and Rose Gold is "Harmony" referencing his music passion. Available in Aqua, Black/White, and Rose Gold at $60.00.

title: Bullseye
content: About the BullseyeThe Bullseye is YoyoFactory's dedicated fingerspin-optimized aluminum throw. Precision-machined center rings guide the finger into the exact landing zone for maximum spin duration, enabling the "longest spins on both string and finger" per YoyoFactory. The 6061 aluminum body features a 10mm stainless steel axle and 19mm slim response pads. Ships unresponsive; a half-spec bearing (sold separately) adds responsive mode. Available in Aqua/Orange, Dark Blue, Pink Aqua Speckle, Galaxy, Black, Blue/Silver Half Swap, Red/Black Fade, and Red at $34.99.

title: California
content: About the CaliforniaThe California is YoyoFactory's 2024/2025 value-tier competition aluminum. At $35.00 it delivers a 56mm diameter with a generous 49.5mm catch zone and a 67.83g weight — slightly heavier than average for enhanced momentum through long combos. The Center Trac C bearing and 19mm thin pads provide standard competition response. Available in Orange, Black, Blue, Red, Pulsar, USA, and "She Never Loved You" colorways, plus a $190 custom set.

title: Czech Point
content:
About
The Czech Point is a bimetal yo-yo from YoyoFactory released in 2015, machined with CNC precision in the Czech Republic. Constructed from 7075 high-strength aluminum with stainless steel weight rings, it brings bimetal performance to a broader audience at an accessible price. The Czech Point's name references its Czech manufacturing heritage and represents YoyoFactory's earliest collaboration with European precision machining. A successor, the CzechPoint (2025), continues this lineage.

title: CzechPoint (2025)
content: About the CzechPoint (2025)The CzechPoint is a revived YoyoFactory design with Czech Republic visual heritage. The 2025 version adds a precision fingerspin hub to the classic unresponsive aluminum platform at 56.6mm diameter and 43.6mm width. The Center Trac bearing and 19mm thin pads provide clean competition response. Available in Aqua/Orange/White, Blue/Yellow, Green/Yellow, Ann Splash, and Black/Grey/Green at $39.99 (compare at $45.00).

title: Demonspeed 2
content: About the Demonspeed 2The DemonSpeed 2 is Angel2Up's bimetal competition signature and a direct evolution of the GODSPEED's speed-first philosophy. The 6061-T6 aluminum body is fitted with stainless steel rims that push rim weighting to the outer edges, dramatically increasing stability and spin time in the 50mm wide profile. At 65.2g and 55mm diameter, it is the most competition-focused model in the Angel2Up line. Available in Black, Galaxy, Silver Rainbow, Orange/Pink, and Purple/Aqua at $79.99 (compare at $99.00).

title: DNA
content: About the DNAThe YoyoFactory DNA features polycarbonate inner caps with a custom geometry that guides the finger into precise placement for fingerspin tricks — particularly the DNA trick (spinning on the finger while the yo-yo orbits). The aluminum body at 54mm diameter and 41mm width is compact and agile. Available in over 10 colorways including Red/Black Cap, Violet/Aqua Cap, Orange/Aqua Fade, Galaxy, Aqua/White Cap, and special Bella Fire DNA at $39.99–$41.99.

title: DNA King
content: About the DNA KingThe DNA King is the premium successor to the DNA, replacing the polycarbonate inner caps with a precision metal fingerspin hub and adding a thumb grind lip for additional trick vocabulary. At 54mm diameter and 47mm width — 6mm wider than the DNA — it provides a larger catch zone while retaining the fingerspin-first philosophy. Available in Golden, Aqua, Red/Silver, Galaxy, and Red/Blue at $59.99–$64.99.

title: DV888
content: About the DV888The DV888 is YoyoFactory's long-running entry-level metal yo-yo and one of the most recommended beginner metal throws in the hobby. Built from 6061 aluminum with a durable anodized surface, it ships with a CBC Large Half SPEC bearing in responsive mode, meaning it returns to the hand with a tug. A separate bearing kit (sold separately) converts it to full unresponsive play. The undersized 50.1mm diameter makes it nimble and easy to handle for players transitioning from plastic. Available in Red/White Caps, Black/White Caps, Galaxy/Clear Cap, and Aqua at $24.99. The DV888 has been in near-continuous production since approximately 2009.

title: Edge
content:
About
The Edge is Harold Owens III's signature yo-yo from YoyoFactory, released in 2016. Machined from 6061 aluminum with an aggressive H-shaped profile, it excels in the technically demanding style of play that Harold champions. Paired with the Edge Beyond, the original Edge established YoyoFactory's Edge line as a cornerstone of competitive catalog.

title: Edge Beyond
content:
About
The Edge Beyond is a wider evolution of the original Edge, released by YoyoFactory in 2017. Retaining the H-shaped 6061 aluminum body, it increases the width for a more forgiving string-rejection and catch zone — adapting Harold Owens III's signature design for evolving competition trends. The Edge Beyond quickly became a popular pick for players favoring wide, stable throws.

title: Elec-Trick Spintop
content: About the Elec-Trick SpintopThe Elec-Trick Spintop is YoyoFactory's bearing-tipped LED spin top. The bearing tip enables long spins for mastering the most difficult top tricks, while the string ring helps beginners develop accurate throws. The LED feature adds a visual effect during spin. Available in LED Clear/White, Fire Marble, Blue Clear, and Smoke Grey/Red at $4.99 (compare at $9.99). Note: not a yo-yo but included in YoyoFactory's product lineup.

title: Essence
content: About the EssenceThe Essence JDS is a dual-signature model designed by Izuru Hasumi (2021 Japan National 1A Champion) and Akitoshi Tokubuchi. Its step-round 6061 aluminum body at 55.97mm diameter and 45.16mm width provides consistent grip for varied hand sizes and delivers "the dependability of the yo-yo, which leaves more power than you can imagine." Suitable for 1A, 3A, and 5A play. Released 2023, manufactured in Japan. Available in Blue Shine, Green, Pink/Aqua, Teal Matte, Gold Shine, Red/Black Matte, and Black/Blue/Grey Shiny at $44.99–$54.99.

title: F.A.S.T. 201
content: About the F.A.S.T. 201The F.A.S.T. 201 (Fully Active Starburst Technology) is one of YoyoFactory's earliest and most recognized beginner models. Its adjustable response system offers three settings: tight for full return, medium for intermediate play, and narrow for slip-string tricks. A CBC Small Spec bearing and starburst response deliver consistent returns for new players. The plastic body is built to absorb the inevitable concrete impacts of learning. Available in Red, Black, and Blue at $11.99. The 201 has been a staple in YoyoFactory's beginner lineup since the company's early years.

title: Flight
content: About the FlightThe Flight is YoyoFactory's dedicated 4A (off-string) yo-yo, engineered from the ground up for aerial tricks. Its extra-wide 59mm body and 77mm diameter make catching the string during aerial maneuvers significantly easier than standard-sized throws. The polycarbonate body is durable enough to survive repeated drops onto hard floors. Bearing size is standard Size C with CBC 19mm Slim Pads. Available in Fire Marble, Aurora Marble, Galaxy, Rayon Vert Green, and Black/Blue Marble at $22.99.

title: FLIGHTECH
content: About the FLIGHTECHThe FLIGHTECH is a collaboration between YoyoFactory and Japan Technology, combining American competitive expertise with Japanese off-string design mastery. Its wide 67.25mm body and 68.87mm diameter ensure easy catches for beginners, while the H-profile shape in POM (Celcon/Duracon/Delrin) provides a smooth, forgiving spin. The smaller-than-Flight diameter also suits children and enables dual-yoyo off-string techniques. Released in 2025 at $54.99. Available in Blue/Black Hub, White/Black Hub, and White/Blue Hub. Collab partner Japan Technology is not currently in the Yoyo Archive.

title: Genesis
content:
About
The Genesis is Hiroyuki Suzuki's signature yo-yo from YoyoFactory, first released in 2009. Machined from 6061 aluminum with a wing-shaped H-profile, it became one of the most iconic competition yo-yos of its era. The Genesis defined YoyoFactory's competition aesthetic and was carried by Hiroyuki Suzuki through multiple World Yo-Yo Championship wins. A later 7075 high-strength version, the Genesis 7075, was produced in limited runs including a special 44CLASH collaboration edition.

title: GENPOP
content:
About
The GENPOP is Ryota Ogi's signature yo-yo from YoyoFactory, released in 2019. Machined from premium 7068 aerospace aluminum, it delivers competition-grade performance at a price accessible to everyday players. The GENPOP name reflects YoyoFactory's mission to bring high-end specifications to the general population of yo-yo players. A companion to the GENPOP Ultra, the original GENPOP became one of the brand's most popular mid-tier offerings.

title: GENPOP Ultra
content: About the GENPOP UltraThe GENPOP Ultra represents YoyoFactory's take on the emerging competition consensus. Rather than being radical, it embodies the "not-too-distant normal in terms of size, shape, feel, and aesthetic." Built from 7068 alloy — stronger than 6061, lighter than 7075 — with highlight annotations at 57.9mm diameter and 51.5mm width. At 66g with a CT bearing it delivers exactly what most competition players seek: nothing surprising, everything solid. Available in Blue, Aqua, Silver/Black, Pink, and Silver/Gold at $60.00.

title: GODSPEED
content: About the GODSPEEDThe GODSPEED is designed by and for Angelo Aguirre, known online as Angel2Up, whose fast fingerspin and technical style demands a throw built for lightning-fast transitions. The 56mm diameter and 40.9mm width deliver a slim, agile profile ideal for quick directional changes between trick elements. At 65.1g in 6061 aluminum, it provides rock-solid stability through long combos. YoyoFactory has released the GODSPEED in one of the largest single-model colorway rosters in their catalog — over 35 options including Orange/Pink, Black/Silver, Purple/Aqua Fade, Gold/Dark Blue, Red, Black, Green, Loverboy, Evil Splash, Halloween, and Christmas editions at $35.00. A titanium GODSPEED variant retails at $249.99.

title: Halo (Metal)
content: About the Halo (Metal)The Metal Halo is Angel2Up's aluminum competition signature released in 2025. Its straight, angular body shape is explicitly designed to minimize air resistance during fast trick sequences, while the PolyCarb fingerspin caps provide a consistent landing zone for DNA tricks. At 65g with a 57mm diameter and 42mm width, the Halo is narrower than most modern competition throws — a deliberate choice optimizing for speed over catch-zone width. Available in Green/Purple, Green/Silver, Aurora Splash, and Red/Silver at $41.99.

title: Halo (Plastic)
content: About the Halo (Plastic)The Halo Plastic is YoyoFactory's 2025 beginner-friendly upgradeable platform. Developed alongside the Metal Halo, it uses a polycarbonate body with an aluminum fingerspin hub and ships with two bearings — a responsive half-spec and a Center Trac for unresponsive play. This allows the player to grow from basic tug returns through to advanced fingerspin and DNA tricks without buying a second yo-yo. Available in White and Black at $17.99.

title: Heist
content: About the HeistThe Heist is a solid stainless steel micro yo-yo at 40mm diameter — the smallest full-steel unresponsive throw YoyoFactory produces. Its density enables spin times and stability typically reserved for full-sized aluminum models. The Small Center Trac bearing (5x10x4mm) and CBC Small Pad response maintain modern unresponsive performance at a scale that fits completely in a shirt pocket. Designed for practicing precision and carrying a full trick repertoire while traveling. Available as a single SKU at $59.99.

title: Horizon
content: About the HorizonThe Horizon was developed in collaboration with Paul Kerbel, Mexican National Yo-Yo Champion. Its defining feature is an exceptionally wide 51mm catch zone — among the widest on any standard yo-yo — which enables both broad string trick catches and the extended fingerspin sessions that made fingerspin tricks a mainstream competition element. At 67.7g and 57.9mm diameter, the Horizon offers a float similar to capped designs while maintaining full unresponsive performance. The tagline "Wide enough for everything, powerful enough for anything" reflects its versatility. Available in Mexico, Galaxy, Rose Gold, Aqua, and Green at $59.99.

title: HUBSTACK Triple Bearing
content: About the HUBSTACK Triple BearingThe HUBSTACK Triple Bearing YoYo is built around YoyoFactory's patented Hubstack technology. Three bearings — a main Large Half Spec for string play, and two side bearings in the hub posts — allow the player to physically grab, pull, and stall the yo-yo while it spins, creating entirely new trick possibilities. Hubstacks were first introduced on the original YoyoFactory 888 and PGM in 2007, and this model brings the concept to an accessible polycarbonate platform at $24.99. Available in Black/Gold, Red/White/Blue, Green/White, and Aqua/White. Ships with both a responsive and unresponsive bearing included.

meta.yya_bearing_size: Large Half Spec + Large Spec + Large Center Trac

title: JDS Boss
content: About the JDS BossThe Boss was originally released by YoyoFactory in 2009 as an undersized H-profile metal that gained a devoted following despite non-standard specs for its era. The JDS Boss is a 2022 redesign by SUS YOYO MECHANICS, widened 3mm from the original while maintaining the H-profile shape and undersized 50.96mm diameter. Wall thickness around the axle was minimized to improve power transfer. Available in standard ($39.99) and Jun special edition ($49.99) colorways: Blue Jun, Silver, Orange Jun, Blue, Red, Green Jun, Gold Jun.

title: LED Loop 720
content: About the LED Loop 720The LED Loop 720 takes the proven Loop 720 platform and adds twin LED lights that create a light-show effect with every loop. The added weight from the LEDs brings the total to 61.8g — heavier than the standard Loop 720 — which increases stability in a way that suits advanced looping. YoyoFactory recommends a break-in period due to increased friction. Available at $22.99 in a single LED/clear colorway.

title: Legend Wing Wood
content: About the Legend Wing WoodThe Legend Wing Wood takes the Legend Wood's fixed-axle wooden construction and applies a modern wing profile to the shape. The wider butterfly profile makes it easier to land string tricks than the traditional rounded shape, bridging the gap between classic wooden play and modern unresponsive technique. Handcrafted and available in Maple Varnish, White, and Raw at $14.99.

title: Legend Wood
content: About the Legend WoodThe Legend Wood is YoyoFactory's classic fixed-axle wooden yo-yo, made in the USA from solid wood with a full paint finish and foil-embossed sticker. Fixed-axle play produces a naturally responsive throw suited for old-school tricks: Walk the Dog, Rock the Baby, Elevator, and Around the World. At 57mm diameter and 31.6mm width, it matches the dimensions of a classic wooden yo-yo. Available in Raw, Black, Blue, and Red at $14.99.

title: Legendary 888
content: About the Legendary 888The Legendary 888 was released approximately 15 years after the original 888 to celebrate YoyoFactory's heritage. It retains the classic 888 dimensions exactly — 50.55mm diameter, 40.92mm width, 66.3g — but fuses aluminum and titanium construction for enhanced strength and a premium feel. The Center Trac Large bearing and 19mm Slim Pads deliver the same smooth unresponsive performance as the original, updated to modern standards. Available in Silver/Blue, Aqua/Silver, and Aqua/Blue at $199.00.

title: Loop 720
content: About the Loop 720The Loop 720 is YoyoFactory's primary competition looping yo-yo and one of the best-regarded 2A throws ever made. Designed for synchronized two-handed looping (2A style), it features a CBC Spec XS bearing, precision-tuned response, and a balanced shape that enables smooth, consistent loops. World champion Shu Takada used the Loop 720 in his America's Got Talent performance. It ships with multiple tuning options and breaks in quickly to a smooth looping response. Available in Yellow, Orange, Bright Green, Red/Black, Maroon, Recon, Matt Szeto signature colorways, and limited editions at $17.99. Named player colorways include Matt Szeto (Maroon and Blue).

title: Loop 900
content:
About
The Loop 900 is YoyoFactory's flagship 2A looping yo-yo, developed in collaboration with 2A World Champion Shinji Saito and released around 2010. Featuring an adjustable gap mechanism that lets players fine-tune their looping response, the Loop 900 became the standard-bearer for competitive 2A play for years after its introduction. Its responsive, snappy play and precise feel made it the choice of champions at multiple World Yo-Yo Championships.

title: Loop Classic
content: About the Loop ClassicThe Loop Classic is a newer looping body design built around the same response characteristics as the Loop 720. The flat cap design — contrasted with the Loop 720's rounded body — redistributes weight for a more stable, powerful looping feel. It ships in five colorways: Red Wreath, Aqua Wreath, Black Gold Wreath, Red Classic, and Aqua Classic at $17.99.

title: MASTERPIECE Miracle
content: About the MASTERPIECE MiracleThe MASTERPIECE Miracle represents YoyoFactory's entry into magnesium yo-yo construction, created as the ultimate signature for World Champions Mir and Miri Kim. A revolutionary internal captured weight ring sits within the rim — positioned inside rather than on the outer edge — to maximize centrifugal force and stability while protecting the weight ring from impacts. The body is magnesium, the internal ring and POM components handle damping, and the steel axle system ensures precision assembly. Ships with a single Miracle Case. Available in standard ($250.00) and Brass/PC weight ($299.00) configurations.

title: MEGA MONSTER
content: About the MEGA MONSTERThe MEGA MONSTER is YoyoFactory's most extreme-geometry bimetal — identical 58mm diameter and 58mm width create a perfectly square profile that should not play well by conventional yo-yo physics, yet does. The aluminum body with a stainless steel ring delivers 68g of rim-weighted momentum. Available in Poison Dart, Speckltacular, America Dip/Splash, Wings (Blue/Silver/Red), Crime Scene Splash, Angel 2up, Galaxy, and Tangy Fade/Splash at $99.00.

title: Mighty Flea
content: About the Mighty FleaThe Mighty Flea holds the distinction of being the world's smallest modern performance yo-yo. At 25.14mm diameter and 20.3mm width, it is a genuine unresponsive throw requiring a bind to return — in a package small enough to sit on a thumbnail. The CBC Mighty Flea bearing and CBC Mighty Flea Pads are custom-manufactured to this unique scale. At 48g it is lightweight, and the challenge of landing string tricks on a yo-yo this size makes it both a novelty and a genuine skill-development tool. Available as a single SKU at $64.99.

title: Miracle (2025)
content: About the Miracle (2025)The 2025 Miracle is the evolution used by Mir Kim to secure his third World Yo-Yo Contest title and win Women's Freestyle honors. The body is wider at 50.75mm (vs the original's 47.86mm) and heavier at 68.86g, providing increased catch zone and spin momentum for "bigger tricks, longer combos, and competition-level power." Built from 7075 aluminum alloy. Available in Red Matte, Silver Matte, Red/Gold Splash, Gold Shiny, Gold Matte, and Red Shiny at $160.00.

title: Miracle (7075 Bimetal)
content: About the Miracle (7075 Bimetal)The Miracle is the signature model used by siblings Mir and Miri Kim to win the 2023 World Yo-Yo Contest title — with Mir also setting the highest competition score in the division's history. Its construction is unconventional: extreme brass rim weight is positioned at a smaller inner diameter, balanced by a polycarbonate cover that expands the outer diameter for protection and increased effective diameter. The 7075 aluminum body provides maximum rigidity. At 66.39g and 55.59mm diameter, it delivers exceptional stability and spin power for the Kims' demanding technical sequences. Available in Champions Collection Silver, Champions Gold, Miri Green 2024, Mir Red 2024, Black, Silver, and Violet at $160.00.

title: Miracle Marvelous
content: About the Miracle MarvelousThe Miracle Marvelous is a long-spin-focused variant of the Miracle line, engineered to minimize central weight and maximize rim momentum. YoyoFactory claims it is "one of the longest spinning production yoyos ever made." Built from 6061 aluminum at 56.5mm diameter and 50.3mm width with 19mm thin pads and a Large Center Trac bearing. Available in Black/Red Rim, Red/Black Rim, Red Shiny, and Gold Shiny at $45.00.

title: Miracle Mini
content: About the Miracle MiniThe Miracle Mini is a 42mm bimetal training tool: smaller target means tighter, more precise muscle memory. YoyoFactory describes the effect of training on the Mini as improving performance significantly when switching back to standard-sized models. At 66g with stainless steel rims in a performance alloy body, it delivers unexpected spin times for its compact form. Available in Red, Black, and Gold at $64.99.

title: Miracle Polycarbonate
content: About the Miracle PolycarbonateThe Miracle Polycarbonate is a machined polycarbonate recreation of the 7075 bimetal Miracle used by Mir and Miri Kim at the 2023 Worlds. It maintains the same 55.59mm-adjacent geometry and delivers "incredible spin power and stability" through precision polycarbonate machining, making the champion's preferred geometry accessible without the $160 bimetal price. Available in Green Center and Red Center at $45.00.

title: MOZ 7075
content: About the MOZ 7075The MOZ 7075 is the signature model of Toya Kobayashi, featuring an upgraded A7075 aluminum body for high hardness and strength over the original MOZ. Stainless steel rims add rim weighting and the step-round body shape excels in speedy playing styles with exceptional control performance and stability. The 47mm trapeze width and large Center Trac bearing enable 1A, 3A, and 5A play as well as horizontal tricks. Available in Black/Silver Splash, Silver/Black Splash, Black/Black Rims, Blue/Silver Rims, Pink/Black/Blue Rims, and Gold at $100.00.

title: Nine Dragons
content: About the Nine DragonsThe Nine Dragons (9 Dragons) is one of YoyoFactory's most mechanically ambitious designs. Its outer shell spins independently of the inner body on a separate set of bearings, creating a visual "Dragon Roar" effect and enabling tricks that are impossible on conventional yo-yos. The main body uses a Large Center Trac bearing while the spinning shells run on Half Spec side bearings. The total system weighs 82.4g — intentionally heavy to maintain momentum through the complex dual-rotation mechanics. Available in Black/Fluorescent, Black/Pink Fade, Galaxy with Glow Caps, Black/Silver with Blue, Aqua with Glow Caps, Orange/Aqua Fade, and several other colorways at $74.99. Replacement shells are sold separately. A bimetal 99 Dragons variant with metal rim-weight was released later.

title: Northstar
content: About the NorthstarThe Northstar was released as a tribute to Jensen Kimmitt's 2010 World Yo-Yo Contest championship. It is a plastic yo-yo with a metal bearing seat and precision-engineered metal weight rings embedded in the outer rim, enabling spin times and stability competitive with full-metal throws at a fraction of the price. At 71.35g it is intentionally heavier than most metals, adding momentum to long trick sequences. The design was groundbreaking in proving that plastic construction could match metal performance with the right weighting. Current production includes fingerspin-capable versions with a special FS cap insert. Available in multiple colorways including Orange Marble, Black Gold, Galaxy, and Blue Marble at $24.99. Kimmitt's original 2010–2011 Northstars are highly collectible.

title: One
content: About the OneThe ONE is YoyoFactory's recommended first yo-yo. Built from durable polycarbonate with a CBC Large Half Spec responsive bearing and thick white brake pads, it returns to the hand with a tug. The slim gap and forgiving shape help beginners develop consistent throws. It has been in continuous production for over a decade and remains one of the best-selling introductory yo-yos in the world. Available in Green, Black, Red, and Blue at $12.99.

title: Pneuma
content: About the PneumaThe Pneuma is the 2025 signature model of Izuru Hasumi, 2021 Japan National 1A Champion. It is a three-layer bimetal: A7075 aluminum body, central stainless steel rim, and A7075 aluminum wing. Placing the steel rim centrally — rather than at the outer edge — creates a unique balance of powerful rotation and soft operability that Hasumi describes as "a sensation like riding in a luxury car." Ships with competition-grade NSK CT bearing, REWIND Japan Pad Standard (Clear) response, and Hasumi's Original Throw signature string. Titanium M4 axle. Available in Red/Gold/Green, Silver/Gold/Silver, Violet/Blue/Silver, Silver, and Black at $159.99.

title: PREVAIL
content: About the PREVAILThe PREVAIL is the debut signature model of Katie Thompson, YoyoFactory-sponsored player and prolific online content creator known for inspiring players worldwide. Thompson collaborated closely on the visual design, producing colorways explicitly built for stage performance and collectible appeal. The 6061 aluminum body features an exceptionally wide 56mm catch zone in a 56.7mm diameter throw, producing a nearly square profile optimized for large-catch-zone trick success rates. Available in Purple Gold, Violet Hues, and Splattered at $59.99.

title: Replay
content:
About
The Replay is an entry-level unresponsive yo-yo from YoyoFactory, released in 2014. Molded from durable polycarbonate, it delivers genuine unresponsive play at a fraction of the cost of metal models. The Replay became a go-to recommendation for players transitioning from responsive to unresponsive — durable enough to withstand learning impacts and precise enough for serious practice. A companion to the Replay Pro, it occupies the more affordable tier of the lineup.

title: Replay Pro
content: About the Replay ProThe Replay Pro is an unresponsive polycarbonate yo-yo famously used by Gentry Stein to win the U.S. National Yo-Yo Contest. It proved that a sub-$20 plastic throw could compete at the highest domestic level. Built from high-strength polycarbonate with a CBC Large Center Trac bearing and slim pad response, it delivers consistent spin and stability for advanced string tricks. The wide 58.2mm diameter and 44mm width create a generous catch zone. Available in Galaxy Marble, Yellow/Purple, Fire Marble, and Aurora (Blue/Green Marble) colorways at $15.99–$17.99.

title: Ricochet
content:
About
The Ricochet is YoyoFactory's full-titanium yo-yo, released in 2015. Machined entirely from titanium, it combines the durability and resonant feel of premium titanium with YoyoFactory's competition-focused geometry. One of the most affordable titanium production yo-yos of its era at approximately $99, the Ricochet brought titanium performance within reach of serious hobbyists. Its durability and smooth play made it a standout in the growing titanium segment.

title: Shutter
content: About the ShutterThe Shutter is arguably the most commercially successful competition yo-yo ever made. Released as the signature of Gentry Stein — USA Champion and 2014 World Yo-Yo Contest winner — it brought 6061 aircraft-grade aluminum performance to a price point accessible to serious hobbyists. Stein also won the 2014 Worlds with the Shutter, cementing its legacy. The 56mm diameter and 44.4mm width deliver a well-balanced catch zone; the CBC Large CenterTrac bearing and CBC Large Slim Pads provide smooth, silent unresponsive performance. Each throw ships with Type-6 polyester string and an instructional guide. Colorways span decades of production: Aqua, Infected Galaxy, Galaxy Pink/Blue, Black/Silver Fade, and Blue/Silver Fade at $44.99–$51.99. The Shutter has spawned two major lineage descendants: the Shutter Wide Angle and the Shutter Elite Bimetal.

title: Shutter Elite Bimetal
content: About the Shutter Elite BimetalThe Shutter Elite Bimetal is Gentry Stein's most advanced competition model. Based on the World Yo-Yo Contest-winning Shutter Wide Angle geometry, it adds stainless steel rims for dramatically increased spin time and stability. The extra-wide 49mm catch zone — 1mm wider than the Wide Angle — combined with bimetal rim weighting produced a world-record performance for longest continuous trick sequence on a single throw. At 66.8g with a center track bearing, it is Stein's current competition standard. Available in 10 colorways: Black/Silver, Red/Silver Rim, Red/Gold Rim, Clear/Rainbow Rim, Aqua/Gold Rim, Galaxy, Aqua/Silver Rim, Aqua/Rainbow Rim, Silver/Silver Rim, Silver/Gold Rim at $119–$130.

title: Shutter Mini
content: About the Shutter MiniThe Shutter Mini is a compact 42mm bimetal that Gentry Stein used as a training tool in preparation for his 2019 World Championship win. The concept: practice on the smaller, more demanding target, then switch back to a full-size throw for effortlessly improved precision. The stainless steel rims account for most of the 66.1g weight distribution, delivering spin times and stability well beyond what the compact size would suggest. Available in Aqua, Galaxy, Rainbow Rim, Red/Silver Rims, and Yellow/Silver Rims at $64.99.

title: Shutter Wide Angle
content: About the Shutter Wide AngleThe Shutter Wide Angle is Gentry Stein's competition refinement of the original Shutter. Released after Stein's 2014 Worlds win, it widens the catch zone from 44.4mm to 48mm at the same 56mm diameter, enabling more ambitious slack and whip tricks. The 6061 aluminum body trims 1.2g from the original (64.3g vs 65.5g) to improve agility. A Size C bearing and CBC 19mm Slim Pads maintain the same response character as the base Shutter. Stein used the Shutter Wide Angle to win the 2019 World Yo-Yo Contest — a second World Championship. Available in 10 colorways including Red w/BiMetal Styling, Aqua, Galaxy 23, Gold Champions, and Orange/Aqua Fade at $54.99.

title: Sky Dancer
content: About the Sky DancerThe Sky Dancer is YoyoFactory's second 4A off-string throw, developed in collaboration with pro players G-Mix and Pisco. At 77mm diameter and 59mm width, it matches the Flight in aerial-catch geometry but features a large CenterTrac bearing and a slightly tighter 2.1mm gap for more precise string returns. Designed to produce long spin times and forgiving re-entries during off-string tricks. Available in Orange, Pink, Red, Aqua Marble, White Marble, and Fire Marble at $24.99 (compare at $35.00).

title: Skyva
content:
About
The Skyva is a polycarbonate yo-yo from YoyoFactory released in 2016, engineered specifically for fingerspin play. Its low-profile center cup allows the yo-yo to balance and spin on a fingertip, enabling spectacular aerial fingerspin combos popularized in modern 1A freestyle routines. Affordable, lightweight, and surprisingly capable for its price, the Skyva introduced fingerspin play to a new generation of players.

title: Space Cowboy
content:
About
The Space Cowboy is a high-performance bimetal yo-yo from YoyoFactory, released in 2014. Constructed from 7068 aerospace aluminum with stainless steel weight rings positioned at the rims, it delivers exceptional spin time and stability required for top-level competitive play. The design prioritizes rim-weight distribution for long, smooth spins on string-intensive trick sequences.

title: SpinStar
content: About the SpinStarThe SpinStar is YoyoFactory's most entry-level responsive yo-yo, designed for absolute beginners. It features a transaxle spool and starburst response system that requires zero maintenance — take it out of the packaging and start throwing. The slim gap and snappy return make it ideal for learning basic tricks like Around the World, Walk the Dog, and Rock the Baby. Available in Aqua, Green, and Red colorways. At $10, it is YoyoFactory's lowest-price bearing-grade throw.

title: Spotlight Plus
content: About the Spotlight PlusThe Spotlight Plus is the wider successor to the Spotlight Ultra, expanding the catch zone from 49.3mm to 60mm at the same 55.9mm diameter. YoyoFactory states the extra width "directly translates to higher trick success rates" for complex slack and whip maneuvers. At 67.3g in 6061 aluminum with a Large Center Trac bearing, it trades some agility for consistency. Available in Blue Silver, Gold, and Red at $55.00.

title: Spotlight Ultra
content: About the Spotlight UltraThe Spotlight Ultra is Hunter Feuerstein's primary competition signature, built from 7068 aluminum — a higher-strength alloy than the common 6061 and 7075. The select blast finish enables grinds, and the wide 49.3mm catch zone at 55.9mm diameter provides generous catch geometry for complex slack and whip sequences. At 64.6g with a Size C bearing and 19mm slim pads, it strikes the balance between power, control, and regeneration that Feuerstein demands in competition. Available in Spicy Lemonade, Black Gold, Silver Gold, Aqua, Teal Green, Green/Yellow/Black Splash, and Rose Gold at $59.99–$64.99.

title: Starlight
content: About the StarlightThe Starlight is Hunter Feuerstein's bimetal competition signature, described as "a reflection of time, experience, and craft" that "shines brightest under the spotlight." The bimetal construction — aluminum body with stainless steel rims — and the ultra-wide 52.45mm catch zone (wider than the Spotlight Plus) deliver maximum stability and catch-zone generosity for Feuerstein's ambitious trick sequences. The dual-tone finishes mirror starburst patterns. Available in Aqua/Gold Rims, Silver/Silver Rims, Silver/Gold Rims, Orange/Black Rims, Aqua/Silver Rims, Silver/Black Rims, and a Rocky Edition at $99.99.

title: Superstar (2009)
content: About the Superstar (2009)The Superstar was the competition flagship of John Ando, who used it to win two World Yo-Yo Contest titles. Its 55.76mm diameter stepped H-profile in 6061 aluminum, combined with built-in Hubstack technology, made it one of the most technically capable competition throws of its era. The Hubstacks enabled grabbing-pull starts and stalls that expanded trick possibilities. YoyoFactory released a 20th Anniversary tribute version maintaining the original specs. Available in Galaxy, Charcoal, Blue/White Champions Collection, and Gold Champions Collection at $59.99.

title: Superstar Fingerspin (2024)
content: About the Superstar Fingerspin (2024)The 2024 Superstar retains the aggressive stepped profile of the original but replaces the Hubstack posts with a low-profile fingerspin hub suited to modern trick vocabularies. Built from 6061 aluminum, it delivers the same core geometry — 57.52mm diameter, stepped round profile — at 66.3g with a Size C bearing and 19mm slim pad response. The fingerspin hub allows DNA-style tricks and horizontal play that the Hubstack-equipped original could not perform. Available in Orange, Green, Blue, and Galaxy at $69.99.

title: Titanium Confusion
content: About the Titanium ConfusionThe Titanium Confusion is YoyoFactory's switchable titanium responsive/unresponsive throw. A Size A ball bearing and YYF Small response system enable classic responsive tug-return play or modern unresponsive bind-return depending on setup. The titanium body is also capable of generating sparks against hard surfaces when used with the appropriate spin technique — an optional flourish the product description notes as available but not required. At 55.95mm diameter, 30.0mm width, and 65.3g, it is compact and heavy for its size. Available as a single SKU at $299.00.

title: TOKI-YO Miracle
content: About the TOKI-YO MiracleThe TOKI-YO Miracle is an ultra-limited collaboration between YoyoFactory and TOKI-YO, with only 14 units produced total. Each unit is hand laser-engraved at TOKI-YO HQ — approximately one full day of engraving time per yo-yo. The Gold variant is exceptionally rare: only 1 of 3 gold-colored versions was made available to the public. Every unit ships with an engraved collector card of authenticity. TOKI-YO is not currently in the Yoyo Archive. Available in Gold ($189.99) and Red/Silver ($189.99).

title: Too HOT
content:
About
The Too HOT is Gentry Stein's signature yo-yo from YoyoFactory, released in 2015. Machined from 6061 aluminum, its H-shaped profile pushes weight to the rims for powerful, stable spins. The Too HOT earned its reputation on the competition stage and became one of YoyoFactory's most celebrated mid-range competition throws, priced accessibly at $45.

title: Turbo Confusion
content: About the Turbo ConfusionThe Turbo Confusion delivers 1990s yo-yo nostalgia through a full aluminum body with retro cork response pads and a Size A bearing for instant tug-return. The cork pads wear in exactly like classic fixed-axle and responsive throws, creating a smooth slide-and-snap response feel. Hubstack mounting spots are machined in for optional future upgrades. At 61.00g and 55.95mm diameter with a slim 35.49mm width, it plays much like a classic metal competition throw with the feel of an old-school plastic. Available in Red, Galaxy, Black, Silver, and Dazed and Confusion at $35.00–$42.00.

title: Turbo Grind Machine
content: About the Turbo Grind MachineThe Turbo Grind Machine (TGM) revives classic aluminum yo-yo engineering: response pads recessed below the surface generate spin via friction without catching the string on the way out. The retro cork response pads provide a smooth slide-and-snap return. A Size A bearing keeps response immediate. The non-removable lenses cap the design. Ships with pouch, 2 lenses, string pack, and 2 replacement response pads. Weighs 55.5g without cap, 63g with. Available in Green, Red, and Black/Gold at $60.00.

title: Velocity
content: About the VelocityThe Velocity carries YoyoFactory's trademark Adjust-O-Matic Dials™, offering over 120 adjustable gap settings. This patented system allows the yo-yo to transition from a fully responsive beginner throw to an unresponsive pro-level model without any disassembly. Built from impact-resistant plastic with a stainless steel CBC Small Spec bearing, it is marketed as "the most versatile yo-yo of the 21st century." Every purchase includes a spare string and instructional guide. The Velocity has served as YoyoFactory's flagship adjustable model for over 15 years and continues to sell at $18.99. Available in Black/Blue, Green/Black, and Blue/Green dial colorways.

title: Wedge
content: About the WedgeThe Wedge is the signature model of USA Champion Evan Nagao. It features a polycarbonate body paired with a 6061 aluminum hub that creates a precision fingerspin pocket. At 67g the throw punches significantly above its $19.99 price point: the aluminum hub provides weight distribution and a genuine fingerspin landing zone, while the polycarbonate shell keeps cost accessible. The 57.5mm diameter and 47.2mm width deliver a competitively-sized catch zone. Available in Fire Marble, Golden Glitter, Green, and Galaxy colorways.

title: Whip
content: About the WhipThe Whip is one of YoyoFactory's most enduring beginner models. Its rim-weighted design provides extra-long spin times uncommon at its $9.99 price point. Built from high-impact plastic with a CBC Half Spec bearing and slim pad response, it ships responsive and is suitable for players just learning to bind. The modern butterfly shape allows it to catch string tricks as skill develops. Available in Blue, Red, Green, and Black. A two-pack option drops the per-unit cost to $5.99 each, making it one of the best entry deals in the hobby.
