title: Protostar Hybrid Ti
content:
History / About
A collaboration between YoYoFactory and mowl recreating the legendary John Ando signature Protostar — originally released by YYF in 2009, it redefined what a plastic yo-yo could be and defined an era of play. The Protostar Hybrid Ti uses a hybrid structure combining polycarbonate and POM materials, leveraging expertise gained from the development of the mowl Hybrid. Three prototypes were required during development. The result combines the soft responsiveness of POM material with stability and solid feel, delivering high-precision performance with exceptional control while faithfully recreating the stunning aesthetics of the iconic original — including the body shape, central hub dome, and weight distribution. Designed for John Ando.

title: Avant Garde
content:
About
The Avant Garde (44CLASH Edition) is the 2011 entry in the ongoing YoYoFactory × 44CLASH partnership. Released in two colorways — Purple (44CLASH logo one side, Avant Garde logo the other) and Gold (44CLASH logo both sides) — both versions featured early two-color anodized logo treatment, a manufacturing technique unusual at the time. The H-profile Avant Garde was already a competition favorite; the 44CLASH edition paired its proven geometry with event-exclusive presentation. Includes multitool, CBC pads, and SPEC bearing.

title: Avant Garde Mini
content:
About
The Avant Garde Mini (44CLASH Edition) is the 2018 YoYoFactory × 44CLASH release, produced for the event's 10th anniversary. The undersized H-profile at 50mm diameter brings the original Avant Garde's geometry down to a more compact form factor, preserving the feel and playability of the larger model in a throw sized for speed-focused players. Smooth coating. The 44CLASH edition released exclusively at the 2018 event.

title: Genesis 7075
content:
About
The Genesis 7075 (44CLASH Edition) is the fifth annual entry in the YoYoFactory × 44CLASH partnership, produced in 7075 super-hard aluminum alloy rather than the standard 6061. The premium material delivers greater hardness and vibration dampening, with a flat axle-side face distinguishing it from the 6061 Genesis variants. Miguel Correa's signature H-profile geometry remained the same competition-proven design — the 44CLASH edition simply brought it in a superior material at a restricted run.

title: Loop 1080
content:
About
The Loop 1080 (44CLASH Edition) is a special colorway of YoYoFactory's Loop 1080, the 2A looping yo-yo developed with two-time World Champion Shu Takada. The Loop 1080 introduced a patented tunable gap mechanism allowing players to dial in response for looping or slipping without disassembling the throw. Released simultaneously with the Protostar 44CLASH in December 2014.

title: Protostar
content:
About
The Protostar (44CLASH Edition) is the 44CLASH × YoYoFactory release for 2014 — a special edition of John Ando's Protostar from YoYoFactory's "Death to Metal" series. The polycarbonate/ABS body fitted with aluminum rim rings delivers metal-level stability and spin power at reduced cost and weight. The low edge minimizes sleep loss during play. A 44CLASH special colorway gave event attendees access to one of the most competition-proven bimaterial designs of the era.

title: Severe 2009
content:
About
The Severe 2009 (44CLASH Edition) is the first collaboration between YoYoFactory and 44CLASH, produced as a special edition of Tyler Severance's signature Severe. The full-metal body is fitted with plastic side caps — one bearing the YoYoFactory logo, the other the 44CLASH mark — making it an instant collector's piece. First made available exclusively at the 2009 44CLASH nightclub event in Yokohama, Japan.

title: 44CLASH Special (2010)
content:
About
The 44CLASH Special (2010) is a YoYoFactory collaboration produced exclusively for the 2010 44CLASH event. Tiny in stature — undersized at 43.8mm diameter — the H-profile design plays like a metal miniature of the POPstar. Five colorways were offered including Blue and Hot Pink. The laser-engraved logo and ~2 minute spin time made it both a functional player and a standout event collectible.

title: Supernova
content:
About
The Supernova (44CLASH Edition) is a limited special edition of YoYoFactory's Supernova, produced as part of the ongoing 44CLASH × YoYoFactory partnership for the 2010 event. The step-straight profile and wide catch zone of the Supernova made it a competition favorite; the 44CLASH edition brought that performance to the event floor in exclusive colorways.

title: YYR Impact
content:
About
Impact, part of the Type Face Inspired Series, takes its motif from the extra-bold “Impact” typeface — a truly impactful shape with a heavy, unique feel. Ships in pull-back/responsive configuration by default; converting to unresponsive bind play requires swapping in a separately-sold full-width bearing such as a DS bearing.

title: CLASH (2009)
content:
About
The CLASH is the inaugural collaboration between 44CLASH and YoYoRecreation, produced to commemorate the 2009 44CLASH event — the world's first yo-yo competition held in a live house (nightclub) setting. Step-straight aluminum construction slightly smaller than the YYR Dreadnought, with heavier rim weighting for improved stability and spin duration. Laser-engraved with both the 44CLASH and YoYoRecreation logos. The CLASH went on to win first place in the 3A division at the 2010 Kyushu Yo-Yo Contest.

title: CLASH 2011
content:
About
The CLASH 2011 is the third 44CLASH × YoYoRecreation collaboration, refining the original 2009 CLASH with a 2-gram reduction in total weight. The trim brings the throw from 70g down to 67.6g, improving maneuverability for fast technical play while retaining the step-straight profile and stable spin characteristics that made the original a competition success.

title: CLASHcube
content:
About
The CLASHcube is the second 44CLASH × YoYoRecreation collaboration, built around a single unusual constraint: diameter equals width. Both dimensions measure exactly 44mm, creating a proportional "cube" geometry unique in the YYR catalog. It is the first YoYoRecreation model to use a D-size bearing — the same bearing used in H-Spin yo-yos — which gave it a distinctly different feel from the rest of the YYR lineup. The step-round undersized profile delivers exceptional maneuverability for complex string sequences.

title: Re Clash
content:
About
The Re Clash is the fifth entry in the 44CLASH × YoYoRecreation series (fourth annual), departing from the original CLASH geometry with a wider body and off-string-esque silhouette. The broader catch zone and thick outer rim deliver high success rates on slack tricks and string catches, while the overall profile remains nimble enough for quick sequential play. Released in three acid-wash colorways: Silver/Green with Splash Purple, Silver/Green with Splash Blue, and Light Blue/Silver with Splash Red.

title: Z01 Focus
content: About the Z01 FocusThe Z01 Focus launched MagicYoYo's Z-series as "a cost-effective bi-metal design built to bring competition-level performance to the masses." A stepped rounded profile concentrates stainless steel rim weight for extended spin through trick combinations. Available on YoYoExpert and specialty retailers worldwide. Colorways: Green with Rainbow Rims, Blue with Rainbow Rims, Blue with Silver Rims.

title: Z02 The Chosen
content: About the Z02 The ChosenThe Z02 The Chosen uses high-precision CNC lathe processing for extremely high rim concentricity, delivering stable and durable sleep performance. Slightly larger than the Z01 at 57mm. A POM response area provides clean, consistent response. Available in multiple colorways from $42 USD.

title: Z03 Redemption
content: About the Z03 RedemptionThe Z03 Redemption uses 7068 aluminum alloy — a premium aerospace-grade aluminum known for its exceptional strength-to-weight ratio — for the body, paired with a 304 stainless steel outer ring. Positioned as a competition and collectors' piece within the Z-series. The KK bearing centers the string for clean trick execution. Includes M4×8mm axles, 10 strings, removal tool, and Allen key.

title: Z04
content: About the Z04The Z04 is a wide hybrid yo-yo combining an aluminum alloy body with polycarbonate outer rims over stainless steel weight structure. At 49.1mm wide it provides a generous catch zone. The 10-ball KK bearing centers the string during complex trick execution. A 2024 upgrade version improved the rim construction. Available in Galaxy and other colorways from gomagicyoyo.com.

title: Z05
content: About the Z05The Z05 sits at the top of MagicYoYo's Z-series. Its 7075 aluminum alloy body is machined to an inner wall thickness of only 0.8mm — requiring extremely high CNC precision — and paired with a TC4 titanium alloy outer ring. Advanced concentricity machining ensures stable, long-lasting sleep performance. Among the most technically demanding MagicYoYo releases below the full-titanium REX. Available from gomagicyoyo.com at approximately $99 USD.

title: Aftermath
content: About the AftermathThe Zeekio Aftermath became one of the brand's most iconic models. Its shape and weight distribution were specifically optimized for modern horizontal play and finger spins, sitting at 53mm — "not too big or small" — with a gap of 4.76mm for reliable unresponsive play. Despite its compact size, it delivers ultra smooth performance with strong stability. The Aftermath's success led to the Aftermath Apocalypse collaboration with Twisted Stringz. Available in multiple splash and solid colorways including Green.

title: Aftermath Apocalypse
content: About the Aftermath ApocalypseThe Aftermath Apocalypse is a collaboration between Zeekio and Twisted Stringz — taking the proven Aftermath platform and elevating it with an "insane anodized finish" completed by Grunt Bull Anodizing in a Meteor Shower Black/Red colorway. It swaps the stock bearing for a Twisted Stringz Trifecta and includes a custom Twisted Stringz string. Priced at $74.99, it delivers the same smooth, fast, stable Aftermath experience in a significantly more premium presentation. All specs match the base Aftermath.

title: Alpha Steel
content: About the Alpha SteelThe Zeekio Alpha Steel sets out to be "the new standard in Steel yo-yos." Its organic shape and undersized 45mm diameter give it an intimate, precise playing feel, while the solid stainless steel construction adds satisfying density. According to Zeekio, it "plays big and heavy for a little yo-yo" with "great spins and smooth landings." Side graphics of a wolf howling at the moon add visual character. The 8mm axle and 18mm response pads make maintenance straightforward, while the flat D bearing suits the tight gap of an undersized steel. Available in Silver-Black Etching, Black-White Etching, and Rainbow-White Etching.

title: Anarchist
content: About the AnarchistThe Zeekio Anarchist features one of the most unique finishes available in the yo-yo market — a combination of rainbow anodization and colored acid wash that gives each piece a distinctive, almost chaotic appearance. At 54mm in diameter and 65 grams, it is well-suited for advanced play. The name reflects the wild, non-conformist aesthetics of each colorway. Available in an extraordinary range of finishes: Silver with Red Splash, Silver, Bronze, Blue, Pink Acid Wash, Yellow Acid Wash, Snow Cone, Nebulus, and Robin Egg.

title: Angler
content: About the AnglerThe Zeekio Angler is a monometal aluminum yo-yo developed by Jake@YYS and Jeff Anderson, designed to be "as 5A friendly as possible." It ships bundled with a Duncan Rapid Ball counterweight, extra strings, and stickers — making it a complete 5A starter kit. At 55mm in diameter and 45mm wide, the Angler provides ample string clearance for counterweight play without sacrificing 1A performance. Fish-themed colorways add character. Also available in a mystery colorway option. Priced at $49.99.

title: Apollo
content: About the ApolloThe Zeekio Apollo is a high-quality, lightweight plastic offstring yo-yo designed for 4A play. Its simple, round design plays with a surprising smoothness, and it comes with an extra string. Available in six colors — Blue, White, Black, Orange, Red, and Yellow — the Apollo was an ideal entry point for players looking to explore offstring tricks without breaking the bank.

title: Apollo II
content: About the Apollo IIThe Apollo II is the next generation of the hugely successful Apollo. Zeekio refined the shape with "a little more chiseled profile to land those really tricky moves," while maintaining excellent regeneration performance thanks to a gap designed for smooth string returns. Available in seven two-tone color combinations — Pink/Black, White/Black, Yellow/Black, Blue/Black, Blue/White, Orange/Yellow, and Red/White — the Apollo II brought upgraded aesthetics alongside improved play characteristics over its predecessor.

title: Bern
content: About the BernThe Zeekio Bern is an unusual bi-metal construction combining machined aluminum with "incredibly well balanced steel rings that provide increased rim weight" and a decorative plastic ring embedded in the side of each half. The steel undergoes plating for a range of color options, while the plastic ring adds a visual accent layer rarely seen on competition-class yo-yos. The result delivers "smooth, stable" performance with extended spin times. Available in Turquoise, Pink, True Blue/Blue Rim, Acid Green, and Blue/Gold Rim. Zeekio notes it is "not associated with any political party or movement."

title: Continuum
content: About the ContinuumThe Zeekio Continuum was designed in collaboration with Dif-E-Yo, the legendary maker of the KonKave bearing. Its organic "O" shape in high-quality machined aluminum is available in precious metal colorways — Silver, Gold, Bronze, and Black. The patented Dif-E-Yo KonKave bearing delivers the centered string performance and long spin times the brand is known for, complemented by silicone sticker response. At 51mm, it is one of the smaller aluminum throws in Zeekio's catalog, but delivers outsized performance thanks to its 69g weight and Dif-E-Yo engineering.

title: Core
content: About the CoreThe Zeekio Core is, in Zeekio's own words, "hands down one of the best competition yo-yos out there." Its full-size, wide shape and perfectly distributed rim weight ensure top performance and reliable stability through the most demanding combo sequences. At 56mm in diameter and 44mm wide, with a 4.76mm gap, it sits squarely in the range preferred by 1A competitors. The Core was popular enough to receive a signature series edition: the Core ShyGuy, honoring David "Shyguy" Lopez, Zeekio team captain and yo-yo ambassador from Spain. Available in Red with Black Splash and Spectrum.

title: Core — ShyGuy Signature
content: AboutSignature edition of the Core honoring Zeekio team captain David "ShyGuy" Lopez. Identical specs to the base Core with premium acid wash and splash anodizing exclusive to this release.ColorwaysBlack/Blue, Green/Gold, Purple/Pink.

title: Flare
content: About the FlareThe Zeekio Flare combines three materials in a single yo-yo: a machined delrin body for smooth grinds and vibrant color, aluminum inner rings that serve as sight lines for trick execution, and stainless steel outer rings that provide rim weight for stability and extended spin times. Zeekio described it as "the highest performing delrin yo-yo ever," and it delivered a level of performance previously unseen at its price point. The composite construction produces ultra smooth grinds while the steel rims keep it on plane through the most aggressive string combos. Available in Red, Yellow, Black, and White.

title: Flare Ultra
content: About the Flare UltraThe Zeekio Flare Ultra is an evolution of the original Flare, growing to 56mm in diameter and opening the gap to 5mm for better unresponsive play. Like its predecessor, it combines machined delrin plastic with aluminum weight rings for rim stability and dual aluminum sight rings to help players target their string tricks. The stainless steel C-size bearing and standard Zeekio silicone pads round out the package. Available in 13 color combinations including White/Green, Yellow/Black, Red/Gold, and Black/Blue.

title: Gemini
content: About the GeminiDescribed by Zeekio as "the fourth off string yo-yo from Zeekio," the Gemini features a modified organic shape, an inner support hub, and strong sight lines to help players land string tricks. Its 10-ball steel bearing and silicone response pads deliver the quality and performance of more expensive yo-yos at an accessible price. Available in White, Green, Blue, Yellow, Red, and Black, the Gemini rounds out Zeekio's comprehensive offstring lineup.

title: Golem
content: About the GolemThe Zeekio Golem is a high-performance yo-yo for intermediate to advanced players. Despite its slightly larger-than-average size (56mm diameter, 44mm width), it plays surprisingly light and "floaty." Deep outer rims are perfectly suited for thumb grinds, and the acid wash and splash anodizing options give it a premium visual quality. Each Golem ships with a Twisted Stringz Trifecta bearing (valued at $13.99) plus an extra flat bearing, making it exceptional value for its $47.99 price. Available in Red/Black, Pink/Gold, and Blue/Gold.

title: Little Evil
content: About the Little EvilThe Little Evil is a collaboration between Zeekio and the legendary Swiss manufacturer HSpin — and notably the last yo-yo ever released with the HSpin logo. HSpin had closed operations in December 2012, but founder Chris Kayatz returned for one final production run through Zeekio. Based on the iconic HSpin Good & Evil, the Little Evil miniaturizes it into a micro stainless steel pocket throw at just 40mm in diameter and 24mm wide. Despite its diminutive size, it delivers remarkable stability and exceptional spin time compared to other micro yo-yos of its era. Priced at $60 and featured by YoYo News in August 2014.

title: Little Evil 2
content: About the Little Evil 2The Little Evil 2 is the follow-up to the groundbreaking Zeekio/HSpin collaboration pocket yo-yo. Maintaining the stainless steel construction and ultra-compact form factor of its predecessor, the Little Evil 2 features a 4.8mm string gap and a Size D bearing for updated performance. Like the original, it is aimed at players who want a high-quality pocket throw that they can carry anywhere without compromising on spin quality. This second run confirmed ongoing interest in the miniature steel format Zeekio and HSpin pioneered together.

title: Lunar Wind
content: About the Lunar WindThe Zeekio Lunar Wind was designed by Sean Collins and Ume to balance performance across various playing speeds. It achieves this through a unique blend of curves and edges that combines an H-shape's stability with a V-shape's speed. An undercut spike enables finger tricks and matador performance, and the bead-blasted finish adds both durability and grip. At 55.75mm in diameter with a modest width of 41mm, the Lunar Wind favors players who enjoy a more focused, precise feel. Available in Purple, Raw Silver, and Midnight Black.

title: Prism
content: About the PrismThe Zeekio Prism was one of the brand's earliest landmark models — an aluminum yo-yo with a revolutionary rainbow anodized finish and an engraved sight line to help players land string tricks. When it spins, it looks steel grey with flashes of color, giving it a unique visual identity. Equipped with a high-quality Trifecta C-size bearing and 19mm silicone pads, the Prism delivered genuine competition performance at an accessible price. Available in Sunset and Rainbow anodizations. The Prism's success laid the groundwork for the later Prism II.

title: Prism II
content: About the Prism IINearly ten years after the original Prism, Zeekio released the Prism II — an updated aluminum model that maintains the revolutionary rainbow anodizing and engraved sight line of its predecessor while introducing a sharper V-shaped profile and slightly larger size. At 56mm in diameter and 43mm wide, the Prism II is more capable of modern aggressive string play than the original. The 8-ball sealed C-size bearing and silicone pad response deliver a reliable performance package. Zeekio noted that "it's been almost 10 years" since the original Prism, making the Prism II a true successor worth the wait.

title: Psycho Spin
content: AboutClassic V-shape 6061 aluminum with a gentle curve for soft string play. Solid unresponsive performance at an accessible price point for intermediate to advanced players.ColorwaysRoyal Blue, Fuchsia, Gold.

title: Quasar
content: About the QuasarThe Zeekio Quasar is a high-performance delrin yo-yo featuring colored power rings that add rim weight for longer spin times and increased stability. The white delrin body contrasted with the colored rings and hub creates a striking visual while the delrin construction delivers smooth grinds. At 68.5 grams, the Quasar sits on the heavier side for a plastic yo-yo, giving it a more solid feel on the string. Available in Blue, Purple, and Red.

title: Quiz
content: About the QuizThe Quiz is a collaboration between Recess and Zeekio — a 100% steel yo-yo with a clean, elegant design inspired by European engineering principles. Its name comes from the United Kingdom, where "quiz" was slang for yo-yos in the 1800s–1900s. Despite its lightweight 64.3g weight for a steel yo-yo, it delivers remarkable power — Zeekio notes that "steel is so dense that you don't need much added volume to the rim in order to feel how powerful your yo-yo is." It ships responsive but converts easily to unresponsive, making it accessible to all skill levels. Includes string, stickers, and a yo-yo pouch. Available in Raw, Black, and Blue. Priced at $90.

title: Rush
content: About the RushThe Zeekio Rush is a "big and beautiful bi-metal that looks fast, plays fast, and has earned the name Rush!" Machined aluminum forms the primary body, while gold-plated steel rings add striking visual contrast and significant rim weight for extended spin times. At 56.5mm in diameter and 44mm wide, the Rush sits in the competitive sweet spot. The gold-plated rings and deep colorways — Black, Gold Rush, and Blue Silver — give it a premium appearance that matches its $74.99 price tag.

title: Saturn H
content: About the Saturn HThe Saturn H is the second entry in Zeekio's Saturn offstring series, and builds on the Saturn V's success with a popular H-shaped profile designed collaboratively with top offstring players. Zeekio called it "one of the finest off-string yo-yos on the market." The high-grade machined delrin construction delivers durability, light weight, and aerodynamic properties critical for 4A play. Available in Black, Blue, Yellow, and White.

title: Saturn V
content: About the Saturn VThe Saturn V takes offstring yo-yo to a new level. Developed with design input from top competitor Philip White, the Saturn V quickly became a premier offstring yo-yo among players worldwide. Its elegant V-shape minimizes friction during trick execution, while the machined delrin construction provides durability, lightweight performance, and aerodynamic feel. Available in Red, White, and Orange, the Saturn V offered a significant step up from the Apollo series for serious 4A competitors.

title: Slim Jim
content: About the Slim JimThe Zeekio Slim Jim is a slimline aluminum yo-yo optimized for snappy responsive play — just a tug and it snaps back. Its slimline body features a pull-start friendly divot and a soft blast finish for grinding tricks. For players who want unresponsive action, the Slim Jim includes an extra axle and bearing that open the string gap for advanced play. Designed by Sean Collins, the Slim Jim ships with a fun "edible surprise." Available in numerous colorways including Rainbow Splash, acid washes, and Super Hero Splash.

title: Spectre
content: About the SpectreThe Zeekio Spectre is a full-size machined polycarbonate yo-yo with a modified H-profile, frosted soft blast finish ideal for grinding, and ghost emblem engravings on the hub for fingerspin targeting. It ships with a Zeekio Trivecta slim responsive bearing and a shorter axle tuned for responsive play. Ghost-themed hand-dyed colorways reference Pac-Man characters: Blinky (red), Pinky (pink), Inky (blue), and Clyde (orange), plus clear options with Blue or Gold hubs. At $24.99, the Spectre delivered impressive machined plastic quality at an entry-level price.

title: Spin Cycle
content: About the Spin CycleThe Zeekio Spin Cycle is a beginner-focused aluminum yo-yo built for durability and versatility. Constructed from aircraft aluminum, it ships in responsive mode for learning basic tricks — long sleeper, walk the dog, brain twister, and trapeze — but includes an extra professional ball-bearing axle and bearing for conversion to unresponsive play. Spinning side hubs add visual flair. The package bundles an extra bearing, tool, strings, glove, and stickers, making it an excellent starter kit. Available in Black, Green, Gold, and Red. Designed by Sean Collins.

title: Splash
content: About the SplashThe Zeekio Splash is one of the brand's earliest all-metal yo-yos, featuring a modified classic shape with a generous gap width for stable unresponsive play. At 52.8mm in diameter and 40.5mm wide, it sits on the smaller side but packs 69 grams into a dense, solid package. Equipped with a Dif-e-Yo KonKave C-sized bearing and silicone pad response, the Splash was positioned as a premium-feeling throw at a time when Zeekio was establishing itself. Available in Burnt Red and Gold.

title: Tempest
content: About the TempestThe Tempest is one of Zeekio's earliest performance aluminum models, featuring a wing-shaped body with curved inner hubs for landing precise string tricks. It shipped with two bearings — a Dif-e-Yo KonKave bearing for unresponsive play and a flat bearing for responsive — plus silicone response and removable rubber weight rings for customizing the feel. The removable rings let players dial in a heavier, more stable throw. Available in Gold/Bronze anodization. Priced at $39.99, it was an exceptional value for a feature-loaded beginner-to-intermediate throw.

title: The Bird
content: AboutUltra-light offstring model from Zeekio at just 65g — significantly lighter than the rest of the Saturn/Apollo lineup. Designed for players who prefer a lighter, more agile 4A setup. Also listed as "Bird Ultra Light."

title: The Murder
content: About The MurderThe Murder is Zeekio's second titanium yo-yo, embodying "the spirit of a beautiful, black flock of crows, known as a Murder." Zeekio positions it as having "set a new standard for what a yo-yo can be," with the evocative tagline "to throw a Murder is to know flight." At 55.9mm in diameter and 46.4mm wide, The Murder is marginally wider than the Z1 while staying at a similar diameter — a configuration well suited to modern tech play. Priced at $270, it is Zeekio's most premium offering.

title: The Ride
content: About The RideThe Ride is a bi-metal from Zeekio featuring a modified H-shape with organic curves running from the rim edges to the bearing seat. Unusually, its steel ring sits closer to center rather than the outer rim — a design choice that gives the yo-yo a "solid but soft" landing feel on the string, making it forgiving for complex tech combos. Aluminum forms the primary body with a stainless steel inner ring adding density and stability. Described as delivering "great spin times, steady as a rock." Available in Royal Blue, Purple, and Silver at $35.00 through wholesale.

title: Vali
content: About the ValiThe Zeekio Vali is the brand's original undersized stainless steel yo-yo, representing Zeekio's commitment to making innovative and quality yo-yos at a good price. Its sharp V-shape and diminutive 43mm diameter give it a nimble, precise feel very different from Zeekio's full-size aluminum models. At 59 grams, it plays heavier than its size suggests — a hallmark of solid steel throws. The Vali's success led directly to the redesigned Vali 2.

title: Vali 2
content: About the Vali 2The Zeekio Vali 2 is a ground-up redesign of the original Vali, featuring "a redesigned chiseled look" with "slightly more favorable weight distribution for increased spin times." Despite remaining undersized at 43mm diameter and 33mm wide, the Vali 2 "plays like a great bigger throw" — solid steel density in a pocket-sized package. The 8mm axle and 18mm silicone response pads allow for precise maintenance, and the flat D-bearing keeps it tight and responsive to tuning. An exceptional choice for players who prefer the unique feel of solid steel.

title: Vapor
content: About the VaporThe Zeekio Vapor is a full-size machined polycarbonate yo-yo featuring a frosted clear finish and a modified H-profile with recessed side hubs for fingerspins. It ships with dual bearings — a standard 8-ball bearing for unresponsive play and a smaller bearing for responsive — plus Zeekio standard silicone pads. Light at 64 grams and wide at 46mm, the Vapor delivers ample width for string tricks at an accessible price. Available in Clear Blue, Black Silver, Black Gold, Transparent Black Pink, and Lime Blue.

title: Vapor (Full Delrin)
content: About the Vapor Full DelrinThe Zeekio Vapor Full Delrin is an evolution of the original Vapor, moving from polycarbonate to full POM (Celcon/Duracon/Delrin) construction for smoother grinds and more refined feel. It features a smooth S-shaped inverse round profile delivering a complex but enjoyable play that combines power and control. A stylish metal hub forms the fingerspin spot over the axle. Includes the Zeekio Trifecta bearing. The M4 x 8mm axle and 19mm slim response pads (OD 19mm) enable precise maintenance. Available in an extraordinary range of colorways including White, USA, Galaxy, Wood Grain, Dino Egg, and numerous hand-dyed options.

title: Volt
content: About the VoltThe Zeekio Volt is a bi-metal yo-yo combining an aluminum body with stainless steel outer rings for maximum rim weight and stability. Zeekio described it as having "a level of energy and smoothness" born from combining the "strength, lightness and smooth spins" of aluminum with the density of steel for extended spin times. The steel rings catch light and flash dramatically when the yo-yo spins, living up to the electric name. Available in Red, Black, Gold, Silver, and Green. Priced at $64.99.

title: Z1
content: About the Z1The Zeekio Z1 is the brand's first titanium yo-yo, designed by Sean Collins with a stepped organic profile that delivers "soft feel and beautiful spins." It is engineered to handle all kinds of tricks, including newer tech tricks, and features a perfect-sized fingerspin area. Each Z1 ships with a center track bearing and a free ten-pack of Twisted Stringz strings. Notably, the Z1 was the first Zeekio yo-yo to feature the new "Z" logo. Priced at $199, it represents Zeekio's commitment to premium materials while remaining more affordable than many titanium competitors.

title: Zenith
content: About the ZenithSince its introduction, the Zeekio Zenith has been one of the most popular Delrin yo-yos on the market. Its 58mm diameter and 43mm width make it one of the largest machined plastic yo-yos available, delivering exceptional stability thanks to generous size and rim weight. The machined plastic construction gives it the smooth feel delrin is known for, making it excellent for grind tricks. Available in over 20 color combinations including Blue/Purple, Blue/White, White/Yellow, Black/Yellow, Fluorescent Yellow/Purple, and many more — making it one of the most colorful yo-yos in Zeekio's lineup.

title: Zepheus
content:
From Layer Infinity:

"Zepheus is a pocket-friendly slimline unresponsive throw! Its shape is a throwback to the popular H shapes in the 2010s.

This thing packs 66 grams under a width of 38mm. It has a rim-weighted design that feels a little dense and heavy on the string."

title: Zephyr
content: About the ZephyrThe Zephyr launched alongside the Thou as Paragon Yoyos' founding product pair in 2024. Sharing identical base dimensions with the Thou — 54.98mm diameter, 43.90mm width — it was designed as its deliberate opposite. Where the Thou prioritizes smooth, organic float, the Zephyr features hard lines and an aggressive, angular profile intended to deliver a more assertive, precise feel on the string. Founder Eric Ngu described the Zephyr as "a stark contrast" to the Thou. Together, the two models represent Paragon's central design philosophy: that different players and different moments call for fundamentally different characters, and that both deserve equal craft.

title: Zephyr II
content: About Zephyr IIThe Zephyr II is an evolved bi-metal design building on the original Zephyr platform. Combines aluminum and stainless steel for optimal weight distribution, spin stability, and trick responsiveness.

title: Zephyr II Hue Quan
content: About Zephyr II Hue QuanSpecial collaboration edition of the Zephyr II with player Hue Quan. Features signature colorway and player-optimized specifications for advanced trick execution.

title: zero 50mm
content: About the zero 50mmThe zero 50mm launched in February 2023 as the undersize entry in At Design Lab's ZeRo series. At 50mm diameter and 60.8g, it references the Duncan Butterfly, Anti-yo Business, and A-RT Sparrow. The Shmoved ring (recessed inner-cup ring) reduces string friction. "Smooth feel and enough spin power even in undersized." Available colorways include Silver/Space Gray (Smooth Ultimatte), Gold/Purple (Vintage), Clear (Vintage), Silky Coating, Snow Coating, and an Aging Coating — nickel slow-aging edition (Oct 2024). ~$99–108 USD.

title: Zero 52mm
content: About the Zero 52mmThe Zero 52mm launched on Valentine's Day 2025 as the final model in At Design Lab's ZeRo series. Inspired by the Anti-yo Eetsit and Bapezilla, the 52.5mm diameter provides a middle-ground between the 50mm and 54mm in centrally-balanced weight distribution. The Shmoved ring reduces string friction. Positioned as the completion of the ZeRo lineup. A Snow Coating Edition was released January 30, 2026. ~$98.99 USD.Colorways: Half Brown/Half Silver (Vintage), Half Light Gray/Half Dark Gray (Smooth Ultimatte), Half Green/Half Blue (Vintage), a sold-out "Bape-polished" limited edition, Snow Coating Edition (Jan 2026).

title: ZeRo 54mm
content: About the ZeRo 54mmThe ZeRo 54mm opened At Design Lab's second product series in August 2023. Where the MoNo series is a W-shape, the ZeRo series is an O-shape (round profile) — the "zero point on a ruler," a design baseline inspired by the Duncan Butterfly as the ancestor of modern string-trick yo-yos, and by the Anti-yo catalog (Eetsit, Bapezilla, YWET, Business, Sparrow). The "Shmoved ring" — a slightly recessed inner-cup ring — reduces string snagging and sleep loss during play.Available in Silver/Space Gray (Smooth Ultimatte), Black/Pink, Snow Coating Edition (Oct 2023), and Silky Coating variants. ~$99–101 USD.

title: ZERO 57mm
content: About the ZERO 57mmThe ZERO 57mm launched August 16, 2024, as the large-format entry in At Design Lab's ZeRo series. At 57mm diameter and 39.5mm width it presents a wide, narrow-profile round shape — described as an "Art Diptych" concept pairing with the Duncan Freehand and Anti-yo YWET as design references. Concept: "Timeless Beauty." Colorway releases span Aged Vintage Coating, polished Vintage, Smooth Ultimatte, and special editions including a Sakura Edition (March 2025) and Aging Coating variants in nickel and copper (October 2024).

title: ZERO minus
content: About the ZERO minusThe ZERO minus was announced September 13, 2024 and sold out within approximately ten days. It shares the exact shell dimensions of the ZERO 57mm but removes significant material to bring the weight down to 58.5g — the "minus" referring to the reduced weight relative to the standard ZERO. The lighter weight shifts the playing character toward a floatier, more effortless feel. Available in a Signature Splash (Silver × Space Gray) finish and an Aging Coating edition (nickel semi-polish, 59g) released October 2024.

title: Zetica
content: AboutThe Zetica is Kohei Nishimura's third signature bimetal (following the Fractal and Tesract), released in 2025. Even wider than the Tesract at 47.61mm, it provides enhanced control performance for larger-movement technique. The 2023 and 2024 Japan National 1A Champion's signature. Available in Shiny Pink; a 7075 variant (Zetica 7075) was also released in a separate colorway.

title: Zillion
content: History / AboutCombines the face/diameter language of the magnesium Sandevistan with Windoundary's wide profile.

title: Business Class Edition
content:
About
The Business Class Edition uses the same 100% polyester multi-layered formula as the Slushy Edition but targets a more refined, elegant color palette — each colorway pairing a bold outer thread with a tonal core. Ideal for players who prefer understated aesthetics without sacrificing performance. Good for responsive play; community reviews note 2+ weeks of durability. Colorways: Deja Blue, Purple Haze, Cherry BOMB, Clockwork Orange, Golden Eye, and Snow White. Sold in 3-packs and 5-pack variety samplers.

title: Executive Class
content:
About
Executive Class is ZipLine's control-focused nylon+ offering — an 80% smooth nylon / 20% soft polyester blend using the Smoothie multi-stage twist. Prioritizes predictability and tension control over raw speed, with wider slack formation and more controllable whip speed than traditional nylon. Community reviews note it "holds string tension better than any string I've ever used" with minimal wear after 4+ hours of play. Reformulated and re-released August 2025 with 5 extra inches versus the prior version, incorporating the ZS.AiR build method. Available in Powder Blue, Lavender, Red, Orange, Gold, and White. 3-packs ($6.75) and 5-pack variety samplers ($11.50). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: FLUFF
content:
About
FLUFF is ZipLine's pure premium nylon string — 100% nylon processed through a multi-stage twist for an exceptionally plush, bouncy, cozy feel. Strong whip and slack speed despite the soft character, with snappy binds. Requires a break-in period. Available in White only. Sold in 3-packs ($7.00). Restocked approximately every 4 months in limited quantities. Released July 4, 2025. Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: -ist
content: -ist is a yo-yo designed by ZipLine Strings teammate Paul Harness and released with ZipLine in February 2021. An earlier December 2020 giveaway featured a prototype before the planned retail release.Sources: February 2021 launch announcement; December 2020 prototype giveaway.

title: [kot-n]
content:
About
ZipLine's [kot-n] is a boutique cotton string designed specifically for fixed-axle wooden yo-yos, blending multiple cotton types through various twist stages. More comfortable than standard cotton and notably durable — fixed-axle player Ed Haponik states it "breaks in great, plays consistently on both sides, holds Kickflip loops wide open, and it LASTS." Break-in time varies: a few tosses with multi-hole response systems or approximately 2 minutes with textured response surfaces. Wax or chapstick can be applied for additional smoothness on worn response surfaces. Described by ZipLine as "laborious" to produce. White only; sold in 3-packs ($6.00). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: MicroLINE
content:
About
MicroLINE is ZipLine's specialty string for micro-sized and mini yo-yos — proportionally scaled in gauge and length for the narrow gaps and compact dimensions of smaller throws. Standard competition and practice strings are too thick for micro yo-yos; MicroLINE fills this gap. Sold individually or in small packs ($3.75). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: PH22
content:
About
PH22 is the signature string of player Paul Harness — a 100% polyester string wound more tightly and thinner than ZipLine's other offerings to minimize response friction. The reduced friction enables wider slack formation and extended play characteristics preferred by Harness for his competitive style. It also served as the foundation formula that the KC24 was built upon. The PH22 is on its final production run and is being retired after current stock sells through.

title: POLYESQUE
content:
About
POLYESQUE is the official retail release of ZipLine's internally developed Case Study No. 122 (CS122) formula — a 70% ZipLine polyester / 30% Airetic nylon blend applied through the same multi-stage twist process as the Poly Classic line. It sits between the pure-polyester strings and the full nylon+ offerings: medium-to-fast whip speed, good slack retention, and a smooth feel that balances performance, visibility, and comfort. Available in HyperTone Green, Yellow, Orange, Pink, and Hybrid White, plus a variety sampler. 3-packs ($4.20) and 5-pack samplers ($7.00). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: Prestige
content:
About
Prestige is ZipLine's signature string for player Nate Martsolf and the brand's first nylon blend signature product. A hybrid polyester/nylon blend described as "uber soft, right from the start" — no break-in required. Delivers excellent slacks and suicides with wide-open execution, amazing slack shape, and solid predictable whip. Originally developed to complement black yo-yos (hence the white colorway). Sold in 5-packs ($6.50) in White. Currently on production hiatus as of mid-2024. Available through YoYoTricks while stock lasts.

title: Rhapsody KC24
content:
About
The Rhapsody KC24 is the signature string of competition player Keiran Cooper and ZipLine's best-selling polyester string for competitive use. Built on the PH22 foundation but with two additional thread strands and tweaked torsion to match Cooper's tension preferences — the result is a slightly thicker feel than PH22, holds tension better, and lasts at least twice as long. Originally developed to complement the SF Yoyos Cadence. Available in neon yellow/white, neon pink/white, neon green/white, neon orange/white, and White, plus the limited Scales Edition (green, sold out). The KC24 is on its final production run — ZipLine has announced it is being retired after current stock sells through.

title: BMC
content: BMC (Backmasked Cadence) is a retail yo-yo produced by ZipLine Strings with SF. ZipLine’s project archive recounts the companies’ agreement to produce SF’s first Cadence prototype as a commercial release in 2020.Sources: ZipLine Projects Archive; August 2020 release-day review.

title: SkyLine III
content:
About
SkyLine III is ZipLine's highest-tier string — an ultra-boosted nylon plus polyester core thread blend, hand-dyed and treated in six signature colorways exclusive to the SkyLine Edition. The string offers a soft premium feel, wide-open slack formation, and air-cutting whip speed, with community reports of "effectively no wear after ~90 minutes." It requires pre-stretching and a double slipknot technique for the finger loop due to its slippery nylon surface. Sold in limited batches restocked approximately every 4 months. Colorways: Highlighter+, Antifreez+, Solar Flare, Disco Pink, Electrolyte Blue, and Whiteout SL. 3-packs ($7.50) and 5-pack variety samplers ($12.75). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: Slushy Edition
content:
About
The Slushy Edition is ZipLine's original flagship string and the model that established the brand. Hand-spun by Jeremy Park's family in Idaho using 100% polyester with a multi-layered core-thread blend, the multi-colored threads appear as solid colors during play. Delivers tight binds, a nice slack shape that holds even after hours of play, and a fun, grippy character. Available in five colorways: Busta Lime, Smurfberry Blast, Grape Escape, Cranberry Crush, and Tangerine Twist. Sold in 3-packs and 5-pack variety samplers.

title: Smoothie Edition v2
content:
About
The Smoothie Edition v2 is a reinvention of ZipLine's original CS50/Smoothie formula, sharing the 70% polyester / 30% Airetic nylon composition of POLYESQUE but distinguished by its five multi-tone colorway treatments and several improvements: increased string length over v1, an updated plush nylon additive, and improved twist torsion for better tension retention. Balances polyester performance with nylon comfort. Colorways: Laser Lime, Banana Slam, Mighty Mango, Strawesome Berry, and Razzleberry Rush. 3-packs ($4.20) and 5-pack samplers ($7.00). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: G2 Diamond Blend
content:
About
The G2 Diamond Blend is a ZipLine string formula produced exclusively for G Squared Yoyos, designed by Jacob Gross. The soft nylon plus ZipLine polyester core thread combination delivers a slick, smooth feel from the nylon side paired with firm rigidness from the performance polyester core — resulting in air-cutting whips, reliable binds, and extended performance well beyond standard polyester strings. Slow to fray, improving with break-in. A later iteration was released with approximately 6 extra inches over the prior version. Sold in 3-packs ($6.50) and 5-packs exclusively through the G Squared Yoyos store. Currently on production hiatus.

title: AlphaLine
content:
About
AlphaLine is the result of a collaboration between ZipLine Strings and Sochi Company: ZipLine contributed the color ratios and performance formulas; Sochi applied their bulk string production methodology. The only factory-made string in the ZipLine lineup, AlphaLine sits in thickness between ZipLine's Performance Edition regular and Sochi's fat string. Quick, sporty whip speed with slack capability, steady tension, and a relaxed-yet-consistent torsion that distinguishes it from typical bulk strings. Sold in 10-packs ($5.50) in Antifreez, Solar Flare, Psycho Sunburn, Disco Flamingo colorways, with Highlighter on hiatus. Available through ZipLine, YoYoExpert, YoYoSam, and Yo-Yo Store Rewind.

title: ZS.AiR
content:
About
ZS.AiR is ZipLine's tribute to the legacy of Airetic Strings — a 100% plush nylon blend using authentic Airetic thread stock processed through ZipLine's multi-stage twist technique. The result is a string described by community members as "one of the best strings I've ever used in my entire life." Super smooth, bouncy, exceptionally whippy, and long-lasting. Sits between the SkyLine III and Executive Class in the Nylon+ lineup. Developed since summer 2023. Available in Green, Yellow, Orange, Pink, and White. 3-packs ($6.75) and 5-pack variety samplers ($11.50). Hand-spun in Idaho, USA.

title: ZipZinger
content:
The Zip Zinger is a one-off prototype yo-yo produced by Anti-Yo. It is made of titanium, but the manufacturing process is not something so commonly seen in other metal yo-yos; metal injection molding (MIM).

A slurry of powdered titanium and an inert binder is mixed together, and then injected into a CNC-milled mold and baked in a kiln. The binder is burned away in the kiln, leaving behind solid titanium.

The yo-yo was slated to enter production and retail release, but it was cancelled due to potentially high production costs. The only prototype that was ever made of this model was remarked to play very fast, being 56 grams in weight. The MIM mold used to produce the Zip Zinger was made at the same machining shop that produced the older BSP. There was a single Titanium Bapezilla made at this time via MIM as well.

title: Zzzip-Fly
content:
History
The Zzzip-Fly was the sole undersized model in the Dif-e-Yo lineup, departing from Frank Difeo's standard 2 1/8" (54mm) diameter that defined virtually every other model. At 1 7/8" (47.6mm), it retained the Dif-Fly profile and KonKave bearing but delivered a noticeably smaller, lighter feel. Made for players who preferred undersized play during an era when the market was beginning to diversify.
